ThinkWAM: Rethinking Latent Futures for Action Refinement VLA

World-action model Latent future prediction Action refinement Robot manipulation Predictive coding

简要说明：ThinkWAM 提出了一种具有提议-反思-优化循环的潜在世界行动模型，通过在执行前使用条件化未来预测来优化动作片段，在机器人操作基准和真实世界分布外条件下取得了出色表现。

TLDR: ThinkWAM introduces a latent world-action model with a proposal-rethink-refine loop that uses proposal-conditioned future predictions to improve action chunks before execution, achieving strong results on robotic manipulation benchmarks and real-world OOD conditions.

Abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of future states. An initial action chunk may be flawed. A future prediction that is not conditioned on the chunk is identical for every proposal and thus carries no proposal-specific signal, limiting its usefulness for refinement before execution. We introduce ThinkWAM, a latent WAM that establishes bidirectional feedback before execution through a proposal-rethink-refine loop: the policy first proposes a complete action chunk, the proposal corrects multi-horizon future latents through a learned residual, and the corrected latents are injected into a second pass of the same action head, which generates the executable chunk. An affordance-guided observation-action memory and a near-fine, far-coarse multi-horizon prediction scheme, both motivated by predictive coding, support this loop, and all prediction stays in latent space. ThinkWAM achieves 98.70% success on LIBERO, 84.76% on LIBERO-Plus without OOD fine-tuning, 85.75%/65.85% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random, and 65.17% on RoboCasa24. ThinkWAM achieves 64.4% mean success across three real-world OOD conditions. The mean two-pass inference latency per action chunk is 153.48 ms on LIBERO, 164.61 ms on RoboTwin, and 101.2 ms on the Galaxea A1Z. Ablations show complementary gains from rethinking and affordance guidance. Diagnostics indicate that proposal-conditioned corrections change both predicted futures and action trajectories, showing that the corrected future representations improve the final action.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型（WAMs）将动作生成与未来状态预测相结合。初始动作片段可能存在缺陷。未以该片段为条件的未来预测对每个提议而言都是相同的，因此不携带特定于提议的信号，限制了其在执行前进行修正的有效性。我们提出ThinkWAM，一种潜在空间世界-动作模型，通过提议-反思-修正循环在执行前建立双向反馈：策略首先提出完整的动作片段，该提议通过学习到的残差修正多时域未来潜变量，随后修正后的潜变量被注入同一动作头的第二次前向传播中，生成可执行片段。由预测编码启发的可供性引导的观测-动作记忆和近细远粗的多时域预测方案共同支持该循环，所有预测均保持在潜在空间中。ThinkWAM在LIBERO上达到98.70%的成功率，在LIBERO-Plus上无需OOD微调即达84.76%，在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Random上分别达到85.75%/65.85%，在RoboCasa24上达到65.17%。ThinkWAM在三种真实世界OOD条件下平均成功率达64.4%。每个动作片段的平均两轮推理延迟在LIBERO上为153.48毫秒，在RoboTwin上为164.61毫秒，在Galaxea A1Z上为101.2毫秒。消融实验表明，反思机制与可供性引导带来了互补性增益。诊断分析显示，提议条件化的修正同时改变了预测的未来状态和动作轨迹，表明修正后的未来表征改善了最终动作。

Authors: Haoyun Tang, Baqiao Deng, Enjin Zhou, Songwen Tian, Keyao Xu, Bowen Jing, Kun Wang, Ke Ma, Zhandong Mei, Huibin Li

WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning Manipulation

Hand Motion Reconstruction Dexterous Teleoperation Egocentric Stereo Policy Learning Visual-Inertial SLAM

简要说明：WinDEX 提出了一套用于野外第一视角立体视频的度量 3D 手部运动重建系统，支持低成本、大规模的灵巧操作数据采集，用于遥操作和策略学习。其精度和速度达到最先进水平，在强化学习策略成功率上超越先前方法，并实现了实时遥操作。

TLDR: WinDEX introduces a metric 3D hand motion reconstruction system for in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, enabling low-cost, large-scale dexterous manipulation data collection for teleoperation and policy learning. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and speed, outperforming prior methods in RL policy success rates and demonstrating real-time teleoperation.

Abstract: Human manipulation data are widely used to train robots for human-like dexterity. However, low-cost, large-scale collection in the wild remains challenging. Existing methods remain limited in geometrically grounded metric-scale reconstruction, real-world generalization and inference speed. We present WinDEX, integrating (1) geometric-temporal optimization for metric 3D hand annotation from in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, combined with visual-inertial SLAM for world-frame reconstruction; (2) WinDEX-Net, an end-to-end, fisheye-native network combining calibrated stereo, local detail and temporal context, with a data-model flywheel of model-assisted annotation and retraining; (3) distilled models for offline reconstruction and causal streaming, supporting reinforcement learning and teleoperation; and (4) low-cost CyberCap stereo-inertial capture, forming the WinDEX-Hand dataset with 1,000 hours of training annotations and held-out human-annotated in-the-wild 2D and independent optical motion-capture evaluation sets. Offline reconstruction runs at 43.61 FPS and causal streaming at 171 FPS. On held-out data, offline reconstruction achieves state-of-the-art accuracy: 14.5 pixels in-the-wild reprojection error and, with visual-inertial odometry, 37.29 mm world-frame joint error. We achieve 7.6 and 3.6 times the task success rates of reinforcement learning policies trained with WiLoR and HaWoR motion references, respectively, and demonstrate real-time arm-hand teleoperation. Project website: https://fruitrabbit.github.io/WinDEX/.

摘要（中文）：人类操作数据被广泛用于训练机器人实现类人灵巧性。然而，在野外环境中进行低成本、大规模的数据采集仍具挑战性。现有方法在几何一致的公制尺度重建、现实世界泛化及推理速度方面仍存在局限。我们提出WinDEX，整合了以下内容：（1）基于几何-时间优化的公制3D手部标注方法，可从野外第一人称立体视频中提取手部信息，并结合视觉-惯性SLAM实现世界坐标系重建；（2）WinDEX-Net，一种端到端、原生鱼眼镜头适配的网络，融合了标定立体视觉、局部细节与时间上下文，并构建了模型辅助标注与再训练的数据-模型飞轮机制；（3）面向离线重建与因果流式处理的蒸馏模型，支持强化学习与遥操作；（4）低成本的CyberCap立体-惯性采集设备，由此构建了WinDEX-Hand数据集，包含1000小时的训练标注数据，以及预留的人工标注野外2D评估集和独立光学动捕评估集。离线重建运行速度为43.61 FPS，因果流式处理速度为171 FPS。在预留数据上，离线重建达到了当前最优精度：野外重投影误差为14.5像素，结合视觉-惯性里程计后，世界坐标系下关节误差为37.29毫米。与分别使用WiLoR和HaWoR运动参考训练的强化学习策略相比，我们的任务成功率分别提升了7.6倍和3.6倍，并实现了实时手臂-手部遥操作。项目网站：https://fruitrabbit.github.io/WinDEX/。

Authors: Hongyu Ma, Hairong Qu, Shiqi Zhao, Yongsong Yang, Kai Shi, Jiahao Ai, Xin You, Peng Yin

AsymEEF: Bimanual Manipulation with Asymmetric End Effectors Manipulation

bimanual manipulation cross-end-effector transfer visuomotor policy teleoperation kinematic teacher anchoring

简要说明：AsymEEF 提出一个框架，将双手操作演示在不同末端执行器形态（二指、三指、五指）之间迁移，无需额外遥操作，利用运动学教师锚定和形态条件解码，并训练跨多对末端执行器的统一视觉运动策略。

TLDR: AsymEEF presents a framework that transfers bimanual manipulation demonstrations across different end-effector morphologies (two-, three-, five-fingered) without additional teleoperation, using kinematic teacher anchoring and morphology-conditioned decoding, and trains a unified visuomotor policy across multiple end-effector pairs.

Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are costly to collect and rarely reusable across end-effectors with different kinematics and action spaces. This burden grows in bimanual manipulation, where each end-effector pair may require new data. We present AsymEEF, a framework for executable cross-end-effector demonstration generation and unified bimanual policy learning. Given a small source dataset, AsymEEF transfers demonstrations to heterogeneous combinations of two-, three-, and five-fingered end-effectors without additional teleoperation. Kinematic teacher anchors provide geometric supervision, while sparse real-world X-Calib anchors correct discrepancies in grasp execution. A shared encoder maps wrist poses and actuator states to a morphology-agnostic latent space, and a morphology-conditioned decoder reconstructs target commands. Generated trajectories undergo replay filtering for task-level executability. The representation also supports a unified bimanual visuomotor policy trained across multiple pairs. Across four simulated and six real-world tasks, AsymEEF improves replay success over adapted transfer baselines, achieves a mean replay-valid expansion gain of 16.6 times in simulation, and is evaluated through downstream policy training on real robots. Project website: https://asymeef.vercel.app/.

摘要（中文）：遥操作示范数据的收集成本高昂，且在不同运动学结构和动作空间不同的末端执行器之间往往难以复用。这一负担在双臂操作中尤为突出，因为每对末端执行器可能都需要全新的数据。我们提出了AsymEEF，一个用于可执行的跨末端执行器示范生成与统一双臂策略学习的框架。在给定少量源数据集的情况下，AsymEEF无需额外的遥操作即可将示范迁移至两指、三指和五指末端执行器的异构组合中。运动学教师锚点提供几何监督，而稀疏的真实世界X-Calib锚点则用于校正抓取执行中的偏差。共享编码器将腕部姿态和执行器状态映射到与形态无关的潜在空间中，形态条件解码器则重构目标指令。生成的轨迹经过重放过滤以确保任务级可执行性。该表示还支持跨多对末端执行器训练的统一双臂视觉运动策略。在四个模拟任务和六个真实世界任务中，AsymEEF相较于适配迁移基线在重放成功率上有所提升，在模拟中实现了平均16.6倍的重放有效扩展增益，并在真实机器人上通过下游策略训练进行了评估。项目网站：https://asymeef.vercel.app/。

Authors: Xiaokang Sun, Ningyue Wang, Kunqi Xu, Guangqi Jiang, Jianglong Ye, Yong Wu, Xueyan Zou

NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning VLA

normalizing flow vision-language-action model maximum likelihood score-based refinement LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：NF-VLA 提出了一种基于归一化流的 VLA 策略，通过精确最大似然训练，在 LIBERO 基准上取得了优异成绩，并利用单一学习密度完成训练、生成和精炼。

TLDR: NF-VLA proposes a normalizing-flow-based VLA policy trained with exact maximum likelihood, achieving strong performance on LIBERO benchmarks with a single learned density for training, generation, and refinement.

Abstract: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

摘要（中文）：自回归归一化流（NFs）为学习和采样连续机器人动作提供了可处理的密度估计。我们证明，单一的最大似然目标即可训练出在操作基准测试中与领先方法相竞争的视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略。我们提出了NF-VLA，它将条件自回归归一化流与基于评分的动作细化相结合。其深—浅架构将视觉、语言和本体感觉前缀条件集中在一个高容量的深层模块中，而无条件的浅层模块则提供共享的可逆动作变换。视觉—语言主干网络与流模型通过高斯平滑动作块上的精确最大似然进行联合训练。同一学习密度在推理时提供单一的基于评分的修正，细化生成的动作以补偿训练时的平滑效应，而无需单独训练的去噪器。NF-VLA在预训练视觉—语言主干网络的基础上于LIBERO上训练，无需机器人预训练，即在四个标准套件上实现了98.35%的成功率，并在同一检查点下无需进一步微调即在LIBERO-Plus上达到72.6%的成功率。消融实验表明，仅深层前缀条件化和基于评分的细化均能提升闭环成功率。综合来看，这些结果确立了精心结构的自回归流作为VLA控制的一种有竞争力的方法，单一学习密度同时支持策略训练、动作生成与细化。

Authors: Ruichen Deng, Qinyu Zhao, Yong-Hyun Park, Mutian Tong, Liang Zheng, Jiatao Gu

Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems Manipulation

cooperative mobile manipulation dynamical systems collision avoidance policy selection temporal adaptation

简要说明：本文提出了CALDS框架，用于协作移动操作，通过调整从示范中学习的单智能体动态系统，实现多机器人协调执行、避障和保持演示行为，并在辅助穿衣、餐厅清洁和抽屉打开等场景中进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper introduces CALDS, a framework for cooperative mobile manipulation that adapts learned single-agent dynamical systems to enable coordinated multi-robot execution with collision avoidance and fidelity to demonstrated behaviors, evaluated in assistive dressing, restaurant cleaning, and drawer opening scenarios.

Abstract: Cooperative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate their motions while ensuring whole-body collision avoidance and preserving task-relevant behaviors. We propose CALDS (Cooperative Adaptation of Learned Dynamical Systems), a framework that enables mobile manipulators to adapt learned single-agent behaviors for coordinated execution. Building on individual dynamical systems (DSs) learned from demonstrations, CALDS enables cooperative adaptation through two key components: Cooperative Policy Selection, which identifies compatible combinations of learned policies, and Temporal Adaptation, which ensures collision-free cooperation while preserving the spatial structure and convergence properties of the original behaviors. We evaluate CALDS across three diverse scenarios: assistive dressing, restaurant cleaning and serving, and drawer opening and object placement. Quantitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in improving task success and enabling safe, coordinated simultaneous execution while maintaining fidelity to demonstrated behaviors.

摘要（中文）：协作移动操作要求机器人在确保全身避碰的同时协调各自的动作，并保持与任务相关的行为。我们提出了CALDS（学习型动力系统的协作自适应）框架，该框架使移动操作机器人能够调整已学习的单智能体行为以进行协同执行。CALDS基于从示范中学习得到的个体动力系统，通过两个关键组件实现协作自适应：协作策略选择，用于识别所学策略的兼容组合；以及时间自适应，在保持原始行为的空间结构和收敛特性的同时，确保无碰撞的协作。我们在三个不同场景中评估了CALDS：辅助穿衣、餐厅清洁与上菜，以及抽屉打开与物体放置。定量结果表明，该方法在提高任务成功率、实现安全协调的同时执行方面具有有效性，并保持了对示范行为的高保真度。

Authors: Saray Bakker, Wendelin Böhmer, Javier Alonso-Mora

ForceHarness: Turning Force into Action and Physics for Frozen Frontier Models Manipulation

force-guided manipulation frozen frontier models self-terminating force primitives physics translation layer zero-shot robot policy

简要说明：ForceHarness通过自终止力原语和物理翻译层，将原始力轨迹转换为带不确定性的物理量，使冻结的API多模态模型能够执行力引导操作，在真机和基准测试中显著提升了零样本成功率。

TLDR: ForceHarness enables frozen API-only multimodal models to perform force-guided manipulation by combining self-terminating force primitives with a physics translation layer that converts raw force traces into physical quantities with uncertainty, improving zero-shot success rates on real robots and benchmarks.

Abstract: Frontier multimodal models can now control robots zero-shot from images, yet many manipulation tasks depend on contact forces that images cannot show. Bringing force to an API-only frozen model raises two challenges. First, contact evolves much faster than an API model can decide, so the system must close the loop on force beneath the model. Second, a frozen model cannot interpret raw force streams, so force must be returned in a form the model can reason about. Therefore, we present ForceHarness, a harness that lets frozen models use force without demonstrations or finetuning. After calibrating hand force from a wrist sensor or joint torques alone, ForceHarness addresses the first challenge with self-terminating force primitives that regulate force on their own and return at a contact event. To address the second challenge, a physics translation layer turns each force trace into physical quantities with uncertainty as the tool result. To evaluate ForceHarness against expert force controllers and learned policies under identical conditions, we also build HiddenPhys, a seven-task MuJoCo benchmark with hidden physical variables. On a real arm without a wrist force sensor, ForceHarness raises the zero-shot success rate of GPT-6 Astra from 3.3% to 90.0%. In simulation, it adds 17.5 percentage points on the public ForceBench suite and 34.3 percentage points on HiddenPhys, surpassing force-aware policies trained on demonstrations on both benchmarks and matching hand-written expert controllers on HiddenPhys. Ablations further show that smaller models make significantly better decisions when given physical quantities rather than raw force values.

摘要（中文）：前沿多模态模型现已能够依据图像对机器人进行零样本控制，然而许多操作任务依赖于图像无法呈现的接触力。将力感知引入仅通过API访问的冻结模型，面临两大挑战。首先，接触力的变化速度远超API模型做出决策的速度，因此系统必须在模型之下构建一个力闭环控制回路。其次，冻结模型无法直接解读原始的力信号流，因此力信息必须以模型能够推理的形式返回。为此，我们提出了ForceHarness——一种使冻结模型无需演示或微调即可利用力信息的框架。仅通过腕部传感器或关节力矩完成手部力标定后，ForceHarness通过自终止力基元解决了首个挑战，这些基元自主调节力并在接触事件发生时返回。针对第二个挑战，物理转换层将每一条力轨迹转化为带不确定性的物理量，作为工具结果输出。为了在相同条件下将ForceHarness与专家力控制器及学习策略进行对比评估，我们还构建了HiddenPhys——一个包含七个任务且具有隐藏物理变量的MuJoCo基准测试集。在无腕部力传感器的真实机械臂上，ForceHarness将GPT-6 Astra的零样本成功率从3.3%提升至90.0%。在仿真环境中，它在公共ForceBench基准集上提升了17.5个百分点，在HiddenPhys上提升了34.3个百分点，在两个基准上均超越了基于演示训练的力感知策略，并在HiddenPhys上达到了与手写专家控制器相当的水平。消融实验进一步表明，当模型获得物理量而非原始力值时，较小的模型能够做出显著更优的决策。

Authors: Ke Sun, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Yike Zhang, Yanzhe Chen, Mike Zheng Shou

CoopDistill: Equilibrium-Guided Multi-Agent Policy Distillation for Cooperative Driving AutonomousDriving

cooperative driving multi-agent reinforcement learning policy distillation potential game connected automated vehicles

简要说明：CoopDistill 提出了一种基于均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架，将势博弈规划与残差多智能体强化学习及比较式 rollout 选择器相结合，在合流、环岛和交叉口场景中提升了协同驾驶的成功率并降低了延迟，且无碰撞。

TLDR: CoopDistill proposes a multi-agent policy distillation framework that integrates potential-game-based planning with residual MARL and a comparative rollout selector to improve cooperative driving in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios, achieving higher success rates and lower delays without collisions.

Abstract: Cooperative driving extends autonomous driving from individual vehicle decisions to joint maneuvers that improve traffic safety and efficiency. Optimization-based methods impose safety constraints but often fix paths to simplify multi-vehicle planning, limiting spatial flexibility. Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) explores alternatives through interaction, but coordinated learning and safe execution remain challenging. Their integration nevertheless faces challenges in exploration efficiency, experience allocation, and execution reliability. To address these challenges, this paper proposes CoopDistill, an equilibrium-guided multi-agent policy distillation framework. A potential-game (PG) formulation provides a fixed-path longitudinal reference, around which a residual MARL policy learns longitudinal acceleration, conflict-approach timing, and lateral path corrections. A hard-case curriculum concentrates experience on interactions that PG leaves unresolved or substantially delayed. A comparative rollout selector evaluates the joint consequences of learned corrections against PG before choosing the executed action. Experiments in merging, roundabout, and intersection scenarios compare CoopDistill with six baselines at four connected automated vehicle penetration levels. Relative to PG, success improves by 2.1--27.1 percentage points and delay decreases by 7.3--27.3\%, with no observed collisions. Code is available at https://github.com/FanGShiYuu/CoopDistill

摘要（中文）：协同驾驶将自动驾驶从单车决策拓展至多车联合 maneuvers，以提升交通效率与安全性。基于优化的方法施加安全约束，但往往通过固定路径来简化多车规划，从而限制了空间灵活性。多智能体强化学习（MARL）通过交互探索可行方案，但协同学习与安全执行仍具挑战性。然而，二者的结合在探索效率、经验分配及执行可靠性方面仍面临困难。针对上述问题，本文提出CoopDistill，一种均衡引导的多智能体策略蒸馏框架。势博弈（PG）公式提供固定路径的纵向参考，在此基础上，残差MARL策略学习纵向加速度、冲突接近时机及横向路径修正。硬案例课程机制将经验集中于PG未能解决或显著延迟的交互情境。比较式 rollout 选择器在执行动作前评估学习修正与PG的联合后果。在匝道汇入、环岛和交叉口场景中的实验，对比了CoopDistill与六种基线在四种联网自动驾驶车辆渗透率下的表现。相较于PG，成功率提升2.1–27.1个百分点，延误减少7.3–27.3%，且未观察到碰撞发生。代码已发布于 https://github.com/FanGShiYuu/CoopDistill

Authors: Shiyu Fang, Sheng Zhao, Jiarui Zhang, Chengkai Xu, Xiaocong Zhao, Peng Hang, Jian Sun

WiTac: Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations for Contact-Rich Manipulation Manipulation

tactile representations VLA policies contact-rich manipulation wrist vision pretrained encoder

简要说明：WiTac 提出一种预训练编码器，将触觉信号与腕部视觉和手部运动融合生成接触表示，并在GR00T N1.7和π0.5等VLA策略中显著提升接触丰富操作任务的成功率。

TLDR: WiTac proposes a pretrained encoder that fuses tactile signals with wrist vision and hand motion to produce contact representations, improving contact-rich manipulation success when conditioned into VLA policies like GR00T N1.7 and π0.5.

Abstract: Similar tactile contacts can call for different corrections depending on the configuration of the hand, object and target. Rather than supplying touch and wrist vision separately, fusing them before policy injection better grounds tactile features in visual context, yielding more accurate contact representations. We introduce Wrist-Informed Tactile Representations (WiTac), a pretrained encoder that learns such representations before action generation. Pretrained on nearly 300 hours of SharpaDex data, WiTac deeply fuses tactile signals with hand motion and wrist views into a comprehensive contact representation. Conditioning downstream VLA policies (GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$) on WiTac substantially improves task success over vision-only base policies across four contact-rich manipulation tasks (+28.8% and +15.0% on average), and further outperforms a wrist-free tactile encoder by 18.8% and 7.5%, respectively. Offline analyses further show that incorporating wrist vision yields more accurate contact descriptors, stronger joint task-contact discrimination, greater feature stability under tactile noise, and clearer action-direction readout from similar contacts. Project page: https://wrist-informed-tactile-representations.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：相似的触觉接触可能因手部、物体与目标的不同构型而需要不同的修正。与其将触觉与腕部视觉分开输入，不如在策略注入之前对二者进行融合，从而更好地将触觉特征锚定在视觉上下文中，生成更精确的接触表征。我们提出腕部信息增强的触觉表征（WiTac），这是一种在动作生成之前学习此类表征的预训练编码器。WiTac 在近300小时的SharpaDex数据上进行预训练，将触觉信号与手部运动及腕部视图深度融合为综合接触表征。将下游 VLA 策略（GR00T N1.7 和 $π_{0.5}$）基于 WiTac 进行条件化处理后，在四项接触密集型操作任务中，任务成功率相比仅使用视觉的基线策略显著提升（平均提升+28.8%和+15.0%），并进一步比不含腕部视觉的触觉编码器分别高出18.8%和7.5%。离线分析进一步表明，融合腕部视觉可生成更精确的接触描述符，增强联合任务-接触判别能力，在触觉噪声下提升特征稳定性，并能从相似接触中更清晰地读出动作方向。项目页面：https://wrist-informed-tactile-representations.github.io/。

Authors: Haotian He, Yiyang Chen, Congsheng Xu, Wenchao Yue, Mingze Ye, Shuai Chen, Yi Yang, Yaping Li, Haonan Wang, Weinan E, Wenzhao Lian, Zhijie Deng

TacBridge: Learning Unified Tactile Representations through Cross-Sensor Correspondence Manipulation

tactile representation learning cross-sensor correspondence masked video pre-training optical tactile sensors robot manipulation

简要说明：TacBridge通过跨传感器对应和掩码视频预训练学习多传感器触觉视频的统一表征，增强了跨传感器泛化和下游任务的可迁移性。

TLDR: TacBridge learns unified tactile representations from multi-sensor tactile videos via cross-sensor correspondence and masked video pretraining, improving cross-sensor generalization and downstream task transferability for robot manipulation.

Abstract: Optical tactile sensors record tactile videos that capture local deformation and its temporal evolution during contact, supporting robot manipulation, force estimation, and tactile representation learning. Differences in imaging geometry, background appearance, illumination, resolution, and deformation response lead to sensor-dependent observations of the same contact across GelSight, DIGIT, GelSlim, TacTip, and other optical tactile sensors. This variability limits representation transfer and the joint use of multi-sensor data. We introduce TacBridge, a framework for learning unified representations from multi-sensor tactile videos through cross-sensor correspondence. Specifically, multi-sensor masked tactile-video pre-training learns spatiotemporal representations across sensors. We then train the same masked model jointly on same-sensor and cross-sensor reconstruction, using paired source and target videos of matched contact events. Experiments on cross-sensor translation and downstream perception demonstrate the cross-sensor generalization and task transferability of the learned tactile representations.

摘要（中文）：光学触觉传感器记录触觉视频，捕捉接触过程中的局部变形及其时间演化，为机器人操作、力估计和触觉表征学习提供支持。由于成像几何、背景外观、光照条件、分辨率及变形响应的差异，同一接触事件在GelSight、DIGIT、GelSlim、TacTip等不同光学触觉传感器上会产生依赖传感器的观测结果。这种差异性限制了表征的跨传感器迁移以及多传感器数据的联合使用。我们提出TacBridge框架，通过跨传感器对应关系，从多传感器触觉视频中学习统一表征。具体而言，多传感器掩码触觉视频预训练可跨传感器学习时空表征；随后，我们利用匹配接触事件的成对源视频和目标视频，在同一掩码模型上联合进行同传感器和跨传感器的重建训练。跨传感器翻译及下游感知任务的实验结果表明，所学触觉表征具备跨传感器泛化能力和任务可迁移性。

Authors: Yongji Fu, Yijiong Lin, Yi Zhou, Yi Qi, Guanqun Cao

Driving the Style: Velocity-Conditioned Whole-Body Control from Motion Demonstrations HumanoidEmbodied

whole-body control velocity-conditioned humanoid motion demonstration reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出一种基于速度条件的人形机器人全身控制方法，通过全身轨迹跟踪奖励将示范运动风格编码到策略中，只依赖紧凑的移动命令和机器人观测，无需运行时参考轨迹，并在真实机器人上实现了鲁棒部署。

TLDR: This paper presents a whole-body control method for humanoid robots that encodes demonstrated motion styles via velocity-conditioned policy learning, achieving robust deployment on real hardware. The approach uses whole-body tracking rewards to supervise a policy conditioned only on compact locomotion commands, eliminating the need for runtime reference trajectories.

Abstract: Achieving human-like behavior on humanoid robots has advanced rapidly by leveraging motion-capture demonstrations rather than hand-crafted cost functions. Adversarial imitation supplies a style signal that lets a policy fulfill a task while adhering to a desired style, but is difficult to transfer to hardware. Whole-body tracking through reinforcement learning instead deploys reliably and imitates demonstrations faithfully, but the resulting policies are conditioned on the future reference, so they require a reference trajectory at runtime and can fail when the motion differs from the training data. We train a humanoid policy directly with whole-body tracking rewards while restricting its actor to compact locomotion commands and robot observations. Reference motion supervises the reward and privileged critic, without supplying reference joint trajectories to the actor or requiring teacher distillation. The demonstrated style is thereby encoded in the policy through the tracking reward, so the robot reproduces the whole-body style under commanded velocities. Trained on a single random-walk motion and commanded with velocity profiles from held-out motions, our policy reaches at least 98\% success in simulation and completes every trial on the Unitree G1. On held-out slow walking, whole-body tracking drops to 2\% success and command-conditioned distillation to 56\%, and both fail on the real robot. On the trained motions, the joint position error of our policy stays within 8\% of whole-body tracking, and it has a higher style coverage than adversarial motion priors (AMP), which fell on the real robot without a safety crane.

摘要（中文）：实现类人机器人的人类行为已通过利用动作捕捉示范而非手工设计的成本函数取得了快速进展。对抗性模仿提供了一种风格信号，使策略能够在遵循期望风格的同时完成任务，但难以迁移到硬件上。相反，通过强化学习进行全身跟踪能够可靠地部署并忠实地模仿示范，但由此产生的策略依赖于未来参考，因此在运行时需要参考轨迹，并且当运动与训练数据不同时可能失败。我们直接使用全身跟踪奖励训练人形机器人策略，同时将其执行器限制在紧凑的运动指令和机器人观测中。参考运动监督奖励和特权评论家，而不向执行器提供参考关节轨迹或要求教师蒸馏。因此，示范风格通过跟踪奖励编码在策略中，使机器人在命令速度下再现全身风格。在单一随机行走运动上训练，并以保留运动的速度分布作为指令，我们的策略在仿真中达到至少98%的成功率，并在Unitree G1上完成所有试验。在保留的慢速行走中，全身跟踪成功率降至2%，命令条件蒸馏降至56%，两者在真实机器人上均失败。在训练运动上，我们策略的关节位置误差保持在全身跟踪的8%以内，并且其风格覆盖率高于对抗性运动先验（AMP），后者在没有安全起重机的真实机器人上失败。

Authors: Murad Dawood, Oezge Drama Berkenkamp, Antonio Gonzales Marin, Nutan Chen

QTOP: Scaling Humanoid Motion Tracking with Quantile Critics HumanoidEmbodied

motion tracking distributional advantage quantile critics sample efficiency humanoid whole-body control

简要说明：QTOP 通过分位数评论家引入分布优势估计，提高了人形运动跟踪 RL 的样本效率，在模拟和真实世界中性能提升高达 10%，并建立了缩放定律。

TLDR: QTOP introduces a distributional advantage estimate for quantile critics to improve sample efficiency in humanoid motion tracking RL, achieving up to 10% better performance in simulation and real-world and establishing a scaling law.

Abstract: Learning human motion tracking policies through reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a core capability that underpins a majority of recent progress in humanoid whole-body control. However, achieving generalization to unseen motions at high fidelity requires jointly scaling training to thousands of GPU and dataset hours. This work hypothesizes that motion tracking is inherently compute-bound because training on a diverse set of motions introduces learning interference, similar to multi-task RL. To tackle this, we propose Quantile Tracking Optimization (QTOP), which improves sample efficiency by introducing a distributional advantage estimate conditioned on state and reference pairs. QTOP outperforms on and off-policy RL baselines both in simulation and real-world tracking scenarios on multiple datasets by up to 10\%. Furthermore, we establish a scaling law for QTOP and find that, aside from scaling predictably, dataset size has minimal impact on performance for moderately sized GPU hour regimes.

摘要（中文）：学习通过强化学习（RL）实现人体运动跟踪策略，已成为支撑人形全身控制领域大多数最新进展的核心能力。然而，要实现对新动作的高保真泛化，需要将训练规模联合扩展至数千个GPU及数据集小时。本研究提出假设：运动跟踪本质上受计算资源限制，因为对多样化动作集合的训练会引入学习干扰，类似于多任务强化学习中的情况。为解决这一问题，我们提出了分位数跟踪优化（QTOP）方法，通过引入以状态和参考对为条件的分布性优势估计，提升了样本效率。QTOP在多个数据集的仿真及真实世界跟踪场景中，相较于在线和离线强化学习基线，性能提升最高达10%。此外，我们建立了QTOP的扩展定律，并发现除可预测的扩展效应外，在中等GPU小时预算范围内，数据集规模对性能的影响微乎其微。

Authors: Markus Peschl, Dana Kianfar, Daniel Dijkman

ACiT: Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers VLA

action chunking proprioceptive prior inverted transformers visuomotor policy manipulation

简要说明：ACiT 提出了一种基于本体感先验的动作分块架构，采用倒置Transformer，以历史关节耦合为主要条件，视觉作为后续校准，在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界任务中提高了操作成功率，并提升了VLA骨干网络。

TLDR: ACiT introduces a proprioceptive-prior action chunking architecture with inverted transformers, where historical joint-coupling forms the primary condition and vision serves as later calibration, improving manipulation success rates on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, and also boosting a VLA backbone.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies condition action prediction on visual and proprioceptive observations. While historical proprioceptive sequences carry rich dynamic priors, current methods treat them as equal to high-dimensional vision, causing the proprioceptive signal to be overwhelmed. To identify what is lost in equal-conditioning fusion, we analyze proprioceptive data and find that strong inter-joint coupling is the key action-determining structure. This finding aligns with the neural sensorimotor loop, in which proprioception first forms a body-centered prior and vision is later calibrated via parietal remapping. Inspired by this, we propose ACiT, Proprioceptive-Prior Action Chunking with Inverted Transformers, which reinforces historical joint-coupling as the primary condition with vision as a later calibration. This design is instantiated through three modules: Inverted State Encoding builds a proprioceptive prior via per-joint tokens and inter-joint self-attention. State-Visual Grounding lets joint tokens query visual evidence, making vision goal- and calibration-only. Inverted Action Chunking decodes per-joint trajectories independently. ACiT improves success rates on most LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tasks, with the largest gains on those that require dynamics and coordination. The same conditioning design transferred to the VLA backbone pi_0-ACiT yields significant gains with better execution efficiency.

摘要（中文）：视觉运动策略基于视觉和本体感受观测来预测动作。尽管历史本体感受序列蕴含丰富的动力学先验，现有方法却将其与高维视觉信息同等对待，导致本体感受信号被淹没。为明确等权条件融合中丢失的信息，我们对本体感受数据进行分析，发现关节间强耦合是决定动作的关键结构。这一发现与神经感觉运动环路相吻合：在该环路中，本体感受首先形成以身体为中心的先前信息，视觉随后通过顶叶重映射进行校准。受此启发，我们提出ACiT——基于倒置变换器的本体感受先验动作分块方法，该方法强化历史关节耦合作为首要条件，而视觉仅作为后续校准信号。该设计通过三个模块实现：倒置状态编码利用逐关节令牌和关节间自注意力构建本体感受先验；状态-视觉对齐使关节令牌查询视觉证据，令视觉仅用于目标识别与校准；倒置动作分块独立解码各关节轨迹。ACiT在多数LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真实世界任务上提升了成功率，在需要动力学与协调性的任务上提升尤为显著。将相同的条件设计迁移至VLA骨干网络pi_0-ACiT，在获得显著性能提升的同时实现了更高的执行效率。

Authors: Haixiang Wu, Zhihao Guan, Yang Yang

TaF-Foundation: Wrench-Grounded Cross-Sensor Tactile Representations Manipulation

tactile sensing wrench estimation cross-sensor transfer representation learning manipulation policy

简要说明：本文提出TaF-Foundation，通过6维力/力矩测量建立跨传感器触觉表示，利用24种传感器的大规模数据集，提升基于触觉的操作策略性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces TaF-Foundation, a framework that learns cross-sensor tactile representations grounded in 6D wrench measurements, collected from a large-scale dataset of 24 sensors, improving tactile-based manipulation policies.

Abstract: Tactile sensing is essential for contact-rich manipulation, yet heterogeneous sensing mechanisms and observation formats hinder cross-hardware transfer. Since physical contact is governed by Newtonian mechanics, we ground tactile representations in six-dimensional wrenches, establishing a common physical reference across sensing mechanisms. Specifically, we pair tactile observations from all sensors with wrench measurements, enabling shared physical supervision without requiring direct tactile-to-tactile pairing between sensors. To support learning at scale, we develop a dedicated acquisition platform and collect over 100 million paired tactile observations and wrench measurements from 24 sensors spanning four families of sensing principles. Building on this dataset, our framework combines sensor-specific input adaptation with a shared tactile encoder. By learning to reconstruct wrenches, the encoder maps observations from different sensors into a shared, continuous feature space grounded in contact physics. To leverage these representations for manipulation, we introduce TaF-Policy, which integrates tactile features with visual observations and robot states to generate action chunks. We evaluate the learned representations through wrench estimation, cross-sensor retrieval, few-shot adaptation to unseen sensors, and robotic manipulation. On the core benchmark, our method reduces single-frame force RMSE by 17.1% and improves cross-sensor retrieval R@1 by 13.11 percentage points over the strongest baseline. In manipulation experiments, TaF-Policy achieves average success rates of 51.33% across three simulated tasks and 46.25% across four real-world tasks, compared with 47.33% and 23.75%, respectively, for the strongest baselines evaluated on the same task sets. Project page: https://mrjiangjm.github.io/TaF-Foundation/.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知对于涉及密集接触的操作任务至关重要，然而异构的传感机制和观测格式阻碍了跨硬件平台的迁移。由于物理接触受牛顿力学支配，我们将触觉表示统一到六维力/力矩矢量上，从而在不同传感机制间建立起共同的物理参考基准。具体而言，我们将所有传感器的触觉观测与力/力矩测量配对，从而在不要求传感器之间进行直接触觉-触觉配对的情况下实现共享的物理监督。为支持大规模学习，我们开发了专用的数据采集平台，从覆盖四类传感原理的24个传感器中采集了超过1亿条配对的触觉观测与力/力矩测量数据。基于该数据集，我们的框架将传感器特定的输入适配与共享的触觉编码器相结合。通过学习重构力/力矩，该编码器将来自不同传感器的观测映射到一个以接触物理为基础的共享连续特征空间中。为将这些表示应用于操作任务，我们提出了TaF-Policy，它将触觉特征与视觉观测及机器人状态相融合以生成动作片段。我们通过力/力矩估计、跨传感器检索、对未见传感器的少样本适配以及机器人操作实验来评估所学表示的性能。在核心基准测试中，我们的方法将单帧力的均方根误差降低了17.1%，并将跨传感器检索的R@1指标相较于最强基线提升了13.11个百分点。在操作实验中，TaF-Policy在三个模拟任务中达到了51.33%的平均成功率，在四个真实世界任务中达到了46.25%的平均成功率，而同一任务集上最强基线的相应结果分别为47.33%和23.75%。项目页面：https://mrjiangjm.github.io/TaF-Foundation/。

Authors: Jiaming Jiang, Yuzhe Huang, Baokun Yang, Hao Liang, Li Gao, Haoran Guo, Pei Lin, Shengcheng Luo, Chenxi Xiao, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao

ARMFUL: Learning Whole-Arm Grasp Configurations for Single-Arm Pickup of Large Objects Manipulation

whole-arm grasp diffusion model point cloud dataset autonomous manipulation

简要说明：本文推出了WAG，一个大型的整臂抓取配置数据集，以及ARMFUL，一种基于扩散模型的流水线，能从点云生成整臂抓取并配合运动规划器执行，在仿真和真实Franka机械臂上均取得较高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces WAG, a large-scale dataset of whole-arm grasp configurations for large objects, and ARMFUL, a diffusion-based pipeline that generates whole-arm grasps from point clouds and executes them with a motion planner, achieving high success in simulation and on a real Franka arm.

Abstract: Many everyday objects, such as storage boxes, baskets, and chairs, are too large or heavy for a gripper to grasp, yet a single arm can still pick them up by wrapping around and supporting them. Such grasps are hard to learn: wrapping motions are difficult to teleoperate, and existing datasets contain little whole-arm pickup data. We introduce WAG (Whole-Arm Grasp Dataset), the first large-scale dataset for single-arm pickup of large objects, with 1.7~million joint configurations across 793 objects. We sample configurations directly in joint space, execute each through squeeze and lift primitives in simulation, and stress-test survivors under active shaking and external forces. To demonstrate the utility of WAG and accomplish the whole-arm pickup task, we develop ARMFUL, a whole-arm pickup pipeline that pairs a diffusion model trained on WAG, generating whole-arm grasps from the object's point cloud, with a motion planner that reaches them collision-free before the same squeeze-and-lift execution. In simulation, ARMFUL reaches 85.4\% lift success on training and 69.9\% on held-out objects, and it lifts the object in 70 of 100 trials on a physical Franka arm across 10 IKEA objects.

摘要（中文）：许多日常物体，如储物箱、篮子和椅子，尺寸过大或过重，常规夹爪难以直接抓取，但单臂通过环绕并支撑的方式仍能将其拾起。此类抓取动作难以学习：环绕动作难以通过遥操作实现，且现有数据集中几乎不包含全身手臂拾取数据。为此，我们提出WAG（全身手臂抓取数据集），这是首个面向大型物体单臂拾取的大规模数据集，涵盖793个物体上的170万组关节构型。我们直接在关节空间中采样构型，在仿真中通过挤压和提升基元执行每种构型，并在主动摇晃和外力作用下对存续构型进行压力测试。为展示WAG的实用性并完成全身手臂拾取任务，我们开发了ARMFUL，一种全身手臂拾取流水线，它将基于WAG训练的扩散模型（从物体点云生成全身手臂抓取）与运动规划器相结合，在相同的挤压-提升执行前实现无碰撞到达。在仿真中，ARMFUL在训练物体上的提升成功率达85.4%，在未见物体上达69.9%；在物理Franka手臂上，针对10个宜家物体进行的100次试验中，成功提升物体70次。

Authors: Xinyi Yu, Yunshuang Li, Daniel Seita, Gaurav S. Sukhatme

Instructions Before Actions: Prospective and Retrospective Language Supervision for Driving Vision-Language-Action Data AutonomousDriving

driving VLA language supervision instruction-following trajectory prediction counterfactual instructions

简要说明：该论文提出了ADVLAT-Engine来同步驾驶指令、视频和轨迹，并评估前瞻性与回顾性语言监督对驾驶VLA模型指令遵循的影响，发现微调能降低轨迹误差但指令效应不一致。

TLDR: This paper introduces ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize driving instructions, video, and trajectories, and evaluates how prospective versus retrospective language supervision affects driving VLA models' instruction-following, finding that fine-tuning reduces trajectory error but instruction effects remain inconsistent.

Abstract: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models can accept navigation instructions, yet predicting a driver's trajectory does not establish that a model follows the instruction. We study how driving-language supervision is collected and evaluated, distinguishing prospective instructions issued before an action from retrospective labels written after observing it. We develop ADVLAT-Engine to synchronize spoken instructions, road-scene video, and vehicle trajectories, and compare three navigation apps on 48 replayed routes. On 87 maneuvers announced by both Google Maps and a passenger, the passenger uses more scene-dependent language. We evaluate four open driving VLAs before and after fine-tuning on prospective navigation-app drives. Fine-tuning reduces passenger-drive trajectory error by 23-59%, but instruction effects remain inconsistent. At real intersections, counterfactual instructions reveal stronger responsiveness: fine-tuned Alpamayo~2 Super gains 31 and 18 accuracy points at 15 and 5~m, while Qwen-Drive follows alternative maneuvers more reliably with a discrete command than with a sentence. We additionally collected retrospective annotations from four people for the driving recordings and describe controlled comparisons of annotation content, timing, and downstream learning; those analyses are pending. Our findings separate maneuver prediction from instruction-following and establish a framework for comparing prospective and retrospective supervision.

摘要（中文）：驾驶视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型能够接收导航指令，然而预测驾驶员的轨迹并不能证明模型真正遵循了该指令。我们研究了驾驶语言监督数据的采集与评估方式，区分了行动之前发出的前瞻性指令与观察行动之后撰写的回溯性标注。我们开发了ADVLAT-Engine，用于同步语音指令、道路场景视频和车辆轨迹，并在48条重放路线上比较了三款导航应用。在谷歌地图和乘客均发布的87个驾驶操作中，乘客使用了更多依赖场景的语言。我们评估了四个开放的驾驶VLA模型，在以前瞻性导航应用驾驶数据进行微调前后分别进行测试。微调将乘客驾驶轨迹误差降低了23%至59%，但指令效果仍不一致。在真实交叉路口，反事实指令揭示了更强的响应能力：微调后的Alpamayo~2 Super在15米和5米处分别提升了31和18个准确率百分点，而Qwen-Drive在备选操作执行上，使用离散指令比使用句子更为可靠。我们还为驾驶录制视频采集了四名人员的回溯性标注，并对标注内容、时机和下游学习进行了受控比较的描述性分析；这些分析尚在进行中。我们的研究将操作预测与指令遵循相分离，并建立了一个比较前瞻性与回溯性监督的框架。

Authors: Angel Martinez-Sanchez, Ross Greer

ExtremeDrive: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Critical Driving AutonomousDriving

safety-critical driving extreme weather trajectory prediction real-world dataset benchmark

简要说明：ExtremeDrive 提出了一个专注于安全关键场景和极端天气的真实世界自动驾驶数据集和基准，实验表明纳入此类数据可提高轨迹预测精度和关键场景成功率。

TLDR: ExtremeDrive introduces a real-world autonomous driving dataset and benchmark focused on safety-critical scenarios and extreme weather, demonstrating that including such data improves trajectory prediction and critical-scenario success rates.

Abstract: Existing autonomous driving datasets and benchmarks provide extensive resources for routine driving, yet real-world data covering safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions remain limited. To address this gap, we present ExtremeDrive, a real-world dataset and benchmark covering emergency maneuvers, complex traffic interactions, and adverse conditions such as slippery or snow-covered roads, alongside routine driving. The dataset comprises 589 driving scenes curated from a larger pool of real-world driving recordings, with calibrated and aligned multisensor data and reviewed annotations of road structure and traffic participants. We further establish a benchmark to evaluate planned trajectories through simulated vehicle execution, measuring safety-related metrics and driving performance. Experiments at equal training set sizes show that incorporating critical driving data reduces trajectory prediction errors and improves mean critical-success rates in critical scenarios. ExtremeDrive provides a unified resource for learning and evaluating autonomous driving in safety-critical scenarios and extreme environmental conditions.

摘要（中文）：现有的自动驾驶数据集和基准为常规驾驶提供了丰富的资源，但涵盖安全关键场景和极端环境条件的真实世界数据仍然有限。为弥补这一不足，我们提出了ExtremeDrive，一个包含紧急操作、复杂交通交互以及湿滑或积雪道路等恶劣条件，同时兼顾常规驾驶的真实世界数据集和基准。该数据集包含从更大规模真实驾驶记录中精选的589个驾驶场景，提供经过标定和配准的多传感器数据，以及经过审核的道路结构和交通参与者标注。我们还建立了一个基准，通过模拟车辆执行来评估规划轨迹，并测量安全相关指标和驾驶性能。在同等训练集规模下的实验表明，纳入关键驾驶数据可降低轨迹预测误差，并提高关键场景中的平均关键成功率。ExtremeDrive为在安全关键场景和极端环境条件下学习与评估自动驾驶提供了统一资源。

Authors: Xinhan Li, Yuhong Jiang, Shiyue Zhao, Junzhi Zhang, Chengkun He, Ruihai Ma, Shijie Zhao, Wenxuan Cheng, Jinbo Lv, Tao Liu

WTR-Drive: World-Task Decomposition with Structured Risk Supervision for End-to-End Driving AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving Drive-JEPA world-task decomposition structured risk supervision NAVSIM

简要说明：WTR-Drive 提出了一种基于 Drive-JEPA 的端到端驾驶规划器，将共享世界估计与提议条件推理分离，并使用结构化风险监督来提升 NAVSIM 基准上的规划得分。

TLDR: WTR-Drive introduces a Drive-JEPA-based end-to-end driving planner that decouples shared world estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning and uses structured risk supervision to improve planning scores on NAVSIM benchmarks.

Abstract: Proposal-conditioned scene predictions can lack a common object-level reference across candidate trajectories. Aggregate planning scores also leave the objects and times associated with violations implicit. We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：基于提议的场景预测可能缺乏跨候选轨迹的通用对象级参照。聚合规划得分也无法体现违规所关联的对象与时间。我们提出WTR-Drive（World-Task-Risk Driving），一种基于Drive-JEPA的规划器，将共享场景估计与基于提议的推理分离。提议无关的世界记忆模块在每轮细化过程中通过重新读取原始视觉特征，估计对象状态、地图结构和未来运动。提议反馈更新残差任务分支，而不回写至世界记忆。该分支通过候选特定的检索和门控视觉反馈引导细化过程。最终的任务读出提供候选条件特征用于评分。我们从现有候选评分滚动中推导结构化风险目标，无需额外调用模拟器。对于责任碰撞和碰撞时间违规，目标编码了事件存在性、共享对象槽的关联性以及首次违规时间区间。在NAVSIM navtest分割上，WTR-Drive在v1上达到了94.66 PDMS，在v2上达到了88.24 EPDMS（专家帧顺序评估）。这些得分分别比已发表的Drive-JEPA值高出0.96和0.44分。候选级分析表明，较高的最佳候选得分可能与较低的选中轨迹得分并存，揭示了候选质量与选择有效性之间的差距。

Authors: Haoyu Xing, Shaobing Ding, Guanglei Zhao, Guanhua Zhao, Nawu Peng, Mingyang Hou

Lift, See, Act: Hierarchical Robot Policy Pretraining with 3D Foundation Models Manipulation

hierarchical pretraining 3D foundation models manipulation policy human video depth-map reconstruction

简要说明：LSA提出了一种层次化机器人策略预训练框架，利用3D基础模型将2D人类视频提升为稠密3D表示，并通过深度图和手部区域引导增强操作策略，在仿真和真实任务中超越当前最优方法。

TLDR: LSA proposes a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that lifts 2D human videos into dense 3D representations using 3D foundation models, then adds depth-map and hand-region guidance for better manipulation policies, outperforming SOTA in simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Robot policy pretraining based on human videos is crucial for improving the policy's generalization ability. One main challenge for this task is the lack of explicit action-relevant representations in such unlabeled data. Recent works tend to estimate 3D hand motion trajectories from videos using 3D foundation models (3D FMs). However, they keep solely the sparse trajectories as supervision, ignoring the rich, fine-grained information produced during the trajectory extraction process. To address this issue, we propose LSA, a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that includes three phases: Lift, See, and Act. Specifically, the Lift phase elevates 2D video observations into dense 3D representations by adaptively aligning features in the policy's shallow layers with the intermediate representations extracted from multiple 3D FMs. Building upon these lifted representations, the See phase equips the policy with explicit geometric and interactive awareness through dual guidance. It introduces depth-map reconstruction to help the model comprehend 3D spatial layouts and utilizes hand region cues to explicitly supervise the encoder's attention toward task-relevant interaction hotspots. Empowered by the dense 3D representation learning and precise spatial guidance, our policy achieves robust and accurate robotic manipulation in the Act phase. Extensive experiments on diverse simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that LSA significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is available at: https://yiyuan00.github.io/Lift-See-Act.

摘要（中文）：基于人类视频的机器人策略预训练对于提升策略的泛化能力至关重要。该任务面临的主要挑战之一在于，此类无标注数据中缺乏显式的动作相关表征。近期研究倾向于利用3D基础模型从视频中估计3D手部运动轨迹，然而，这些方法仅保留稀疏轨迹作为监督信号，忽略了轨迹提取过程中产生的丰富细粒度信息。为解决这一问题，我们提出LSA，一种包含三个阶段（提升、感知、执行）的分层机器人策略预训练框架。具体而言，提升阶段通过自适应对齐策略浅层特征与多个3D基础模型提取的中间表征，将2D视频观测提升为稠密3D表示。在此基础上，感知阶段通过双重引导赋予策略显式的几何感知与交互感知能力：一方面引入深度图重建以帮助模型理解3D空间布局，另一方面利用手部区域线索显式监督编码器关注任务相关的交互热点区域。凭借稠密3D表示学习与精确的空间引导，我们的策略在执行阶段实现了鲁棒且精准的机器人操作。在多种仿真及真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，LSA显著优于当前最先进的方法。项目主页：https://yiyuan00.github.io/Lift-See-Act。

Authors: Yiyuan Ge, Changxing Ding, Ziyu Hao, Zijie Zheng, Xiangmin Xu

ReRead: Wrong Predictions, Useful Representations - Correcting Frozen Robot Policies by Re-reading Their Own Representations Manipulation

robot policy correction action residual frozen backbone offline demonstrations representation re-reading

简要说明：ReRead 提出了一种冻结主干矫正器，通过重新读取冻结机器人策略的缓存表示来预测动作残差，在困难的 RoboTwin 任务和真实双臂机器人上提高了成功率，且延迟极低。

TLDR: ReRead proposes a frozen-backbone corrector that re-reads cached representations from a frozen robot policy to predict action residuals, improving success rates on hard RoboTwin tasks and a real dual-arm robot with minimal latency.

Abstract: When a pretrained robot policy fails on challenging tasks, common remedies include retraining the backbone, adding an external visual encoder, or introducing a memory module. We argue that wrong predictions do not imply wrong representations: a policy can retain the required information yet fail to read it out as the correct action. To test this view, we propose ReRead: with the backbone frozen, a corrector re-reads the current and two previous caches to predict an action residual. The corrector sees no images, is trained solely on offline demonstrations from all 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, and adds only 4.17% latency. Ablations and interventions show that the correction relies on the backbone's own representations: none of four external visual encoders adds further gain, and swapping in past caches from other trajectories sharply increases action error. On the 11 hardest RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ReRead improves the success rates of LingBot-VLA, $π_{0.5}$, and Fast-WAM by 23.45, 13.09, and 8.00 percentage points, respectively. In paired evaluation on all 50 tasks, it raises Fast-WAM's average success rate from 90.73% to 92.66%. On a Flexiv dual-arm robot, it raises success on a phase-ambiguous task from 0% to 36%.

摘要（中文）：当预训练的机器人策略在挑战性任务中失败时，常见补救措施包括重新训练骨干网络、增加外部视觉编码器，或引入记忆模块。我们认为，错误预测并不意味着错误表征：策略可能保留了所需信息，却未能将其读出为正确动作。为验证这一观点，我们提出ReRead方法：在冻结骨干网络的情况下，一个校正器重新读取当前及前两个缓存，以预测动作残差。该校正器不接触图像，仅在所有50个RoboTwin 2.0任务的离线演示数据上训练，且仅增加4.17%的延迟。消融实验与干预测试表明，该校正依赖于骨干网络自身的表征：四种外部视觉编码器均未带来额外增益，而将其他轨迹的历史缓存替换进来会显著提高动作误差。在RoboTwin 2.0的11个最难任务中，ReRead将LingBot-VLA、π₀.₅和Fast-WAM的成功率分别提升了23.45、13.09和8.00个百分点。在全部50个任务的配对评估中，它将Fast-WAM的平均成功率从90.73%提升至92.66%。在Flexiv双臂机器人上，它将在相位模糊任务中的成功率从0%提升至36%。

Authors: Xu Su, Shunlong Xiao, Qintao Yi, Mingkuan Zhao, Xinmiao Yu, Yizhe Li, Zihan Wang, Bokui Chen

Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

flow-matching self-distillation vision-language-action reinforcement learning GRPO

简要说明：本文提出VLA-SSD方法，通过将流匹配动作头自蒸馏为随机一步策略，降低了视觉-语言-动作模型的推理延迟并增加了样本多样性，在LIBERO基准上实现了大幅加速和更好的后训练性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces VLA-SSD, a method that self-distills a flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy to reduce inference latency and increase sample diversity for RL fine-tuning of vision-language-action models, achieving large speedups and improved post-training performance on the LIBERO benchmark.

Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $π_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $π_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.

摘要（中文）：基于流式的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过模仿学习在机器人领域取得了优异性能，然而，利用在线策略强化学习（RL）对其进行微调仍存在局限。在基于组的强化学习方法（如组相对策略优化，GRPO）中，每次采样步骤都需要进行多步常微分方程积分，且采样器的随机性有限，导致生成的样本组方差较低。我们提出VLA-SSD，以同时解决高推理延迟和随机性不足这两个问题。具体而言，我们的方法将预训练的流匹配动作头自蒸馏为一个随机单步策略，通过将单步生成器以布朗路径为条件实现。我们通过该随机单步策略推导出条件动作密度，从而能够利用似然比强化学习算法进行高效的后训练。我们证明，从$π_0$ VLA蒸馏得到VLA-SSD后，动作头的前向传播时间缩短了7.7倍，而在LIBERO基准测试中成功率仅相对下降5.5%。然而，利用VLA-SSD在组生成过程中带来的更大样本多样性，使用GRPO对$π_{0.5}$ VLA进行后训练可带来20.6%的相对性能提升。

Authors: Jingru Guo, Alessandra Russo, Joey Bose, Christos Ziakas

DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping Manipulation

cross-embodiment dexterous grasping reinforcement learning canonical joint interface Transformer-XL memory

简要说明：DexFormer 2.0 提出了一种用于跨具身灵巧抓取的统一强化学习策略，通过规范关节接口、运动学树偏置注意力和 Transformer-XL 记忆，实现到未见过的臂手组合和手型的迁移，并展示了零样本仿真到真实世界的迁移。

TLDR: DexFormer 2.0 introduces a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping, using a canonical joint interface, kinematic-tree-biased attention, and Transformer-XL memory to transfer across unseen arm-hand pairs and hands, demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

Abstract: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers. Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/.

摘要（中文）：灵巧抓取策略通常是为单臂配单手进行训练的。每新增一种臂-手组合就需要重新训练策略，且策略数量会随臂和手的增加而不断增长。我们探索是否可以用单一策略控制多种臂-手组合，并将其泛化到从未见过的组合及手型上。这一目标颇具挑战性，因为不同机器人的关节数量、布局和动力学特性各不相同，导致其观测和动作缺乏统一的接口。我们提出了DexFormer 2.0，一个用于跨形态灵巧抓取的单强化学习策略。该策略将每个机器人映射到一个带有效性掩码的规范关节接口，通过由运动学树引导的注意力机制编码每个关节的形态，并利用Transformer-XL记忆从近期交互中推断与具体形态相关的动力学特性。在四种手臂和六种手组成的18种组合上训练后，该策略在已知组合上达到89%的稳定成功率，在六种未参与训练的臂-手组合上达到51%的成功率，优于GRU和DexFormer 1.0基线。无需微调，该策略还能用四种新手型完成抓取，并通过重定向适配平行夹爪。消融实验表明，记忆机制、运动学树偏置以及更广泛的组合覆盖对迁移性能均至关重要。在实体Flexiv机械臂上，蒸馏后的学生模型能够从仿真零样本迁移到两种手型（包括一种未参与训练的组合）。项目网站：https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/。

Authors: Lixin Xu, Ke Zhang, Xinyu Liu, Jie Tan, Senming Tan, Jiaju Yin, Yating Feng, Xiaoyi Lin, Xiyue Dong, Renjing Xu

Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift VLA

Vision-Language-Action actuation shift inference-time adaptation motor babbling frozen policy

简要说明：ReGround 是一种推理时方法，冻结 VLA 策略并在执行偏移（如延迟、重新安装）下重新校准其预期运动，通过学习部署动力学并跟踪策略计划，在 LIBERO 任务中恢复接近最优的成功率。

TLDR: ReGround is an inference-time method that freezes a VLA policy and re-grounds its intended motion under actuation shift (e.g., latency, remounting) by learning deployed dynamics from motor babbling and tracking the policy's plan, restoring near-oracle success across LIBERO tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $π_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在理想环境下产生期望的机器人行为。然而，当机器人执行机构在部署时发生变化，这些模型往往会失效。例如，重新安装、机械磨损或指令延迟变化可能导致任务失败和不安全行为。为解决这一不可避免的执行机构偏移问题，我们提出ReGround，一种推理时方法，保持VLA冻结不变并重新锚定其意图运动。ReGround通过任务无关的电机随意动作学习部署机器人的动力学，随后在跟踪策略意图运动的同时，保持与策略自身计划的接近。ReGround仅在检测到偏移时激活，且无需奖励、示范或重新训练。我们通过两个VLA模型、八个LIBERO任务及五种偏移设置验证了ReGround能够恢复接近理想状态的成功率，例如在400毫秒延迟下将π₀.₅的成功率从0.16提升至0.90，同时比线性校准基线更安全。项目网站及开源代码：https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/。

Authors: Umer Siddique, Peilang Li, Yongcan Cao

DAPPT: Domain-Aware Policies from Procedural Trajectories for Sim-to-Real Dexterous Tool Use Manipulation

sim-to-real dexterous manipulation procedural trajectories domain randomization policy distillation

简要说明：DAPPT提出了一种针对涉及可变形/颗粒材料的灵巧工具使用技能的sim-to-real强化学习框架，通过从程序化轨迹学习领域感知策略并蒸馏为端到端感知运动策略，实现了zero-shot真实世界迁移并提升了任务指标。

TLDR: DAPPT presents a sim-to-real RL framework for dexterous tool-use skills involving deformable/particle materials, learning domain-aware policies from procedural trajectories and distilling them into end-to-end sensorimotor policies, achieving zero-shot real-world transfer and improved task metrics.

Abstract: Sim-to-real RL has achieved impressive results in dexterous manipulation but remains limited to tasks with accurate rigid-body simulation. However, these methods cannot be applied to skills that involve deformable and particles, with which the simulation speed will become too slow for large-scale RL learning. We present DAPPT, a sim-to-real framework for end-to-end dexterous tool-use manipulation skills, e.g., sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, without simulating non-rigid materials. Our method learns a domain-aware RL policy by tracking procedural trajectories parameterized by domain parameters, and distills it into an end-to-end domain-aware sensorimotor policy. Furthermore, explicit domain represen-tation enables fast selection of domain parameters that can maximize downstream task performance. We evaluate DAPPT end-to-end on six dexterous manipulation tasks, including sand scooping, play-dough rod-rolling, sand scraping, mouse-wheel scrolling, dispenser pressing, and spray triggering. Our method achieves 1.5-3.8x in task metrics through the best domain parameter and transfers zero-shot to the real world.

摘要（中文）：模拟到现实的强化学习在灵巧操作方面取得了显著成果，但仅限于具有精确刚体模拟的任务。然而，这些方法无法应用于涉及可变形体和颗粒物的技能，因为其模拟速度将变得过慢，难以支撑大规模强化学习训练。我们提出了DAPPT，一个用于端到端灵巧工具使用操作技能的模拟到现实框架，例如铲沙、擀黏土棒，且无需模拟非刚性材料。我们的方法通过学习由域参数参数化的程序化轨迹，训练一个领域感知的强化学习策略，并将其蒸馏为端到端的领域感知感觉运动策略。此外，显式的领域表示能够快速选择最大化下游任务性能的域参数。我们在六项灵巧操作任务上对DAPPT进行了端到端评估，包括铲沙、擀黏土棒、刮沙、滚轮滚动、按压分配器和触发喷雾。我们的方法通过最佳域参数在任务指标上实现了1.5至3.8倍的提升，并零样本迁移到现实世界。

Authors: Beining Han, Jia Deng

LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control WorldModel

video world model hand control interactive generation few-step generation efficient video decoding

简要说明：本文提出了LynnReal-Hand，一个手部控制的视频世界模型，支持在交互式视频生成中直接操作物体，通过手部感知监督、因果流映射、区域感知分数蒸馏和高效的Ultra-Fast-VAE，在单张H200上实现了实时流式生成。

TLDR: This paper introduces LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that enables direct object interaction in interactive video generation, featuring hand-aware supervision, causal flow maps for few-step generation, region-aware score distillation, and an efficient Ultra-Fast-VAE, achieving real-time streaming performance on a single H200.

Abstract: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型能够通过文本和相机控制实现探索，但直接的物体交互需要更精细的控制。手部提供了一种自然的交互界面，然而，由于手部-物体动态的复杂性以及实时计算的高要求，将连续的手部动作转化为连贯的视觉响应仍然具有挑战性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了LynnReal-Hand，一种手部控制的视频世界模型，它将精确的交互建模与高效的流式生成相统一。我们整理了涵盖多样化真实与合成环境的10万段交互片段，并开发了手部感知监督以改进细粒度的手部动作和物体交互。在此基础上，我们学习了一种用于少步生成的因果流映射，并引入了区域感知分数蒸馏，结合互补的视频与图像先验，以优化交互动态和视觉外观。为进一步降低推理延迟，我们提出了Ultra-Fast-VAE，一种紧凑的视频解码器，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持较高的重建保真度。在HandBench上的广泛评估表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在手部跟踪精度和视觉质量上均表现更优。我们的全序列模型实现了181.67的FVD和93.02的MANO Dice分数，而三步因果模型保持了92.49的MANO Dice分数。在实时交互方面，在单个H200上进行540p流式生成可达18.03 FPS，延迟为741ms，优化后的峰值GPU内存占用仅为34.89GB。我们将发布数据集、模型权重以及完整的训练和推理代码，以支持手部控制视频世界模型的研究。

Authors: Shaohao Rui, Chaoyang Zhang, Xiaofeng Mao, Weijie Ma

POKE: Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

visual token pruning action sensitivity distillation inference speedup VLA

简要说明：POKE 提出基于动作敏感度的视觉 token 剪枝方法，将离线全图敏感度蒸馏到轻量学生网络中，避免昂贵的在线评分和评分图锁定问题，在 LIBERO 上实现显著加速同时保持高成功率。

TLDR: POKE introduces action-sensitivity-based visual token pruning for VLA models, distilling offline full-graph sensitivities into a lightweight student to avoid costly online scoring and scoring-graph lock-in, achieving significant speedups on LIBERO while maintaining high success rates.

Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference cost of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, but attention-based scores do not directly measure a token's effect on the predicted action. We define action sensitivity as the magnitude of the first-order action change when a token is replaced by its camera's mean token and estimate it for all tokens with a single backward pass. Computing it online is costly: scoring on the full (unpruned) graph needs an extra forward pass at every control step. Scoring on the pruned forward pass is cheaper but causes scoring-graph lock-in: removed tokens lose their direct paths through later layers and tend to receive lower scores, making those locations less likely to return. On replayed observations, even with a random conditioning mask, pruned-graph scoring re-selects 59% of the mask's tokens, versus 6% expected by chance; attention histories show a similar bias. POKE (Probe Offline, Keep Efficiently) computes full-graph action sensitivities offline and distills them into a student with under 0.3M parameters. At inference, the student scores the current observation without backpropagation or previous masks, and score-guided diversity selection retains the tokens. Keeping 32 of 512 visual tokens on LIBERO, POKE achieves 95.2% success on OpenVLA-OFT and 90.8% on $π_{0.5}$ at $1.85\times$ and $1.26\times$ speedups, outperforming attention-, diversity-, and distillation-based pruners, with larger margins on LIBERO-Plus.

摘要（中文）：视觉标记剪枝降低了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理成本，但基于注意力的分数并不能直接衡量某个标记对预测动作的影响。我们将动作敏感性定义为当某个标记被替换为其所在摄像头的均值标记时，一阶动作变化的幅度，并通过一次反向传播对所有标记进行估计。在线计算该指标的代价较高：在完整（未剪枝）图上进行评分，每个控制步都需要额外的前向传播。而在剪枝后的前向传播上评分虽然更便宜，却会导致“评分图锁定”问题：被移除的标记在后续层中失去直接通路，往往获得更低的分数，从而使其更不易被重新选中。在回放观测中，即使使用随机条件掩码，基于剪枝图的评分仍会重新选中掩码中59%的标记，而随机期望仅为6%；注意力历史记录也显示出类似的偏差。POKE（离线探测、高效保留）方法在离线状态下计算完整图上的动作敏感性，并将其蒸馏到一个参数量不足30万的学生网络中。在推理时，该学生网络无需反向传播或依赖先前的掩码即可对当前观测进行评分，并通过分数引导的多样性选择来保留标记。在LIBERO基准上，当从512个视觉标记中保留32个时，POKE在OpenVLA-OFT上达到95.2%的成功率，在π₀.₅上达到90.8%，同时分别获得1.85倍和1.26倍的加速，优于基于注意力、多样性和蒸馏的剪枝方法，且在LIBERO-Plus上的优势更为显著。

Authors: Jaehyuk Lee, Yeajin Lee, Suhyun Bae, Donghun Lee

FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies VLA

VLA policies test-time training flow-aware gating visual conditioning robotic manipulation

简要说明：FAVR 是一种轻量级框架，通过测试时训练和优化的通道门控将流感知视觉特征注入冻结的动作头，以增强预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，并在 RoboTwin 基准上以极少参数提升了操作成功率。

TLDR: FAVR is a lightweight framework that enhances pretrained VLA policies by injecting flow-aware visual features into frozen action heads via test-time training and optimized channel gating, improving manipulation success rates on RoboTwin benchmarks with minimal parameters.

Abstract: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

摘要（中文）：预训练视频表示为机器人操作提供了丰富的时序信息，但如何有效地将其整合到现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中仍是一个挑战。我们提出了流感知视觉残差对齐（FAVR），一个用于冻结VLA策略的流感知视觉条件化的轻量级框架。FAVR通过线性测试时训练（TTT）维护紧凑的时序视觉状态，并在基于流的动作生成过程中检索动作条件化的视觉特征。通过利用冻结动作头的仿射结构，我们明确刻画了注入的视觉特征如何影响预测的动作速度，并将流感知通道选择建模为盒约束优化问题。我们开发了一个基于FISTA的求解器用于联合门控优化，并通过对角化和重缩放推导出高效的闭式近似。仅凭1.74-2.19M的可训练参数和5,000步自适应，FAVR在多个基准上提升了预训练VLA策略的性能。在RoboTwin 2.0上，FAVR将LingBot-VLA在干净条件下的成功率从87.12%提升至90.04%，在随机条件下从86.88%提升至89.38%。在五个RoboTwin任务上的受控消融实验进一步表明，流感知门控将平均成功率从跨流步骤共享门控时的72.0%提升至82.0%，展示了在动作生成过程中自适应视觉条件化的优势。

Authors: Qixuan Wu, Xiaole Yang, Yuguang Yang, Canyu Chen, Linlin Yang, Haixia Pan, Guodong Guo, Baochang Zhang

Competent Autonomous Driving Through Fine Tuning Vision Language Action Models with Symbolic Traffic Rules AutonomousDriving

VLA model symbolic traffic rules reinforcement learning CARLA simulator rule compliance

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的规则引导的 VLA 框架，通过 RL 微调引入符号交通规则反馈，在 CARLA 仿真中同时提高了动作预测准确性和规则合规性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a rule-guided VLA framework for autonomous driving that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback via RL fine-tuning, improving both action prediction accuracy and rule compliance in CARLA simulations.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a unified approach to perception, reasoning, and control for autonomous driving, but accurate action prediction alone does not establish compliance with traffic regulations. This paper presents a rule-guided VLA framework that incorporates symbolic traffic-rule feedback into policy optimisation. The framework combines supervised fine-tuning on expert demonstrations with reinforcement learning (RL) refinement using a reward that encourages encoded-rule compliance while penalising deviations from expert actions. Selected provisions of the United Kingdom Highway Code are formalised as executable first-order logic rules using PyReason, covering speed adaptation, following distance, and road-user priority. A frozen vision-language model extracts scene predicates, which are combined with vehicle-state information to assess the projected consequences of candidate control actions. Offline evaluation on held-out data collected in the CARLA simulator compares three group-based RL methods. The results show improvements in both action prediction accuracy and encoded-rule compliance over the supervised baseline. The best-performing variant increases the overall rule pass rate from 92.9% to 97.6%, with zero observed violations of the encoded road-user-priority check in the evaluated samples. These findings support symbolic rule feedback as a means of improving VLA policy alignment with explicit traffic-rule criteria.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为自动驾驶提供了一种统一的感知、推理与控制方法，但仅凭精确的动作预测并不足以确保符合交通法规。本文提出了一种规则引导的VLA框架，将符号化交通规则反馈纳入策略优化过程。该框架结合了基于专家示范的监督微调和强化学习（RL）精化，其中强化学习使用一种奖励机制，既鼓励遵守编码规则，又惩罚偏离专家动作的行为。英国《高速公路法典》中的部分条款被形式化为可执行的一阶逻辑规则，并使用PyReason实现，涵盖速度适应、跟车距离和道路使用者优先权等方面。一个冻结的视觉-语言模型提取场景谓词，并与车辆状态信息相结合，以评估候选控制动作的预期后果。基于CARLA模拟器中采集的留出数据的离线评估，比较了三种基于分组的强化学习方法。结果表明，与监督基线相比，动作预测准确率和编码规则符合率均有所提升。表现最佳的变体将总体规则通过率从92.9%提升至97.6%，且在评估样本中，编码的道路使用者优先权检查未出现任何违规情况。这些发现支持将符号化规则反馈作为提升VLA策略与明确交通规则标准对齐的一种有效手段。

Data-Driven Predictive Control for Autonomous Vehicle Racing under Varying Friction AutonomousDriving

data-driven predictive control autonomous vehicle racing varying friction pooled data model predictive control

简要说明：本文研究了自动驾驶赛车在轮胎-路面摩擦变化下的数据驱动预测控制(DPC)，表明在不同摩擦条件下合并数据可保持预测精度和控制性能，无需显式摩擦估计即可实现部分自适应。

TLDR: This paper studies data-driven predictive control (DPC) for autonomous vehicle racing under varying tire-road friction, showing that pooling data from different frictions maintains prediction accuracy and control performance comparable to matched data, providing partial adaptation without explicit friction estimation.

Abstract: Data-driven predictive control (DPC) predicts future outputs by combining recorded input-output trajectory data such that the combined trajectory approximately matches a measured initial trajectory and tracks a provided reference. This paper investigates to what extent and under which conditions DPC using data pooled across operating conditions retains the prediction accuracy of DPC using data from the current operating condition. In autonomous vehicle racing, the tire-road friction varies between racetrack sections and tire sets. If the initial trajectory and the recorded data originate from different frictions, prediction accuracy of DPC degrades. Ensuring the frictions match requires knowing the friction during recording and estimating the current friction explicitly. Instead, we pool data recorded at different frictions. We compare the prediction accuracy of DPC using data recorded under the current friction (matched), a different friction (mismatched) and data pooled from both frictions. We evaluate in simulation and small-scale vehicle experiments in the Cyber-Physical Mobility Lab (CPM Lab). Our results show that pooled data keep the multi-step root-mean-square prediction error within 1.5 times that of matched data, whereas mismatched data increase it by a factor of 2.2 to 3.4. To assess how this prediction accuracy carries over to control, we evaluate the tracking error from the raceline in closed loop. In simulation, DPC with pooled data tracks comparably to nonlinear model predictive control (13.7 cm versus 13.3 cm) and close to DPC with matched data in the CPM Lab, differing by 0.1 cm on the low-friction tires (1.6 cm versus 1.5 cm) and by 0.2 cm on the high-friction tires (0.9 cm versus 1.1 cm). DPC thus provides partial adaptation to varying friction, without a dedicated adaptation method.

摘要（中文）：数据驱动预测控制（DPC）通过将记录的输入-输出轨迹数据与实测初始轨迹近似匹配并跟踪给定参考轨迹，从而预测未来输出。本文研究了在何种程度及何种条件下，使用跨运行条件汇总的数据进行DPC，能够保持使用当前运行条件数据时DPC的预测精度。在自动驾驶赛车中，轮胎-路面摩擦系数因赛道区段和轮胎组而异。若初始轨迹与记录数据来自不同摩擦条件，DPC的预测精度会下降。确保摩擦条件匹配需在记录时知晓摩擦系数，并显式估计当前摩擦系数。本文转而采用汇总自不同摩擦条件的数据。我们比较了在当前摩擦条件下记录的数据（匹配）、不同摩擦条件下的数据（失配）以及两者混合汇总数据对DPC预测精度的影响。我们在仿真及信息物理移动实验室（CPM Lab）中的小规模车辆实验中进行了评估。结果表明，汇总数据的多步均方根预测误差保持在匹配数据误差的1.5倍以内，而失配数据则使误差增大2.2至3.4倍。为评估预测精度对控制的影响，我们在闭环中评估了偏离赛道的跟踪误差。仿真中，使用汇总数据的DPC跟踪性能与非线性模型预测控制相当（13.7 cm对比13.3 cm），在CPM Lab中与使用匹配数据的DPC接近，低摩擦轮胎上相差0.1 cm（1.6 cm对比1.5 cm），高摩擦轮胎上相差0.2 cm（0.9 cm对比1.1 cm）。因此，DPC无需专门的自适应方法即可实现对变化摩擦条件的部分自适应。

Authors: Julius Beerwerth, Julius Tischbein, Bassam Alrifaee

Safe Physical Interaction of All-Electric Heavy-Duty Robotic Manipulators via Control Barrier Functions and Variable Impedance Control Manipulation

control barrier functions variable impedance control virtual decomposition control heavy-duty manipulator physical interaction safety

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于全电动重型机器人机械臂的安全感知物理交互控制架构，结合可变阻抗控制与控制屏障函数，在保证工作空间和作动器安全边界的同时，将交互力显著降低。

TLDR: This paper presents a safety-aware control architecture for all-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators, combining variable impedance control with control barrier functions to ensure safe physical interaction near obstacles and under actuator limits, achieving significant reductions in interaction forces while maintaining safety margins.

Abstract: All-electric heavy-duty robotic manipulators are increasingly expected to operate close to tunnel walls, equipment, and other structures while retaining the force capability required for large-payload tasks. Accurate motion control alone does not address the resulting safety and interaction requirements. This paper develops a safety-aware physical-interaction architecture that combines variable impedance control (VIC) with control barrier functions (CBFs) on top of an established virtual decomposition control (VDC) framework for electromechanical linear actuator (EMLA)-driven manipulators. VIC continuously adapts the task-space stiffness and damping according to predicted proximity and contact risk, whereas a joint-velocity CBF filter enforces Cartesian workspace boundaries and the physical stroke limits induced by the closed-chain lift and tilt mechanisms. To account for nonideal realization of the filtered velocity by the inner VDC/EMLA dynamics, the CBF inequalities are tightened using a measured bound on the joint-velocity tracking error. Four configurations, namely VDC, VIC+VDC, CBF+VDC, and VIC+CBF+VDC, are evaluated under workspace, actuator-limit, and physical-interaction scenarios. VIC reduces the peak and RMS environment-interaction forces by 92.59% and 96.33%, respectively; both robust CBF configurations maintain positive workspace and EMLA safety margins, while VIC+CBF+VDC reduces the CBF intervention metric by 10.30% compared with CBF+VDC.

摘要（中文）：全电动重型机器人操作器日益需要在靠近隧道壁、设备及其他结构的环境下作业，同时保持完成大载荷任务所需的能力。仅依靠精确的运动控制并不能满足由此产生的安全与人机交互需求。本文提出了一种安全感知的物理交互架构，在已有的用于机电线性执行器（EMLA）驱动操作器的虚拟分解控制（VDC）框架基础上，将可变阻抗控制（VIC）与控制屏障函数（CBF）相结合。VIC根据预测的接近距离和接触风险，持续调整任务空间中的刚度与阻尼；而关节速度CBF滤波器则用于约束笛卡尔工作空间边界以及由闭链升降和倾斜机构引起的物理行程限制。考虑到内层VDC/EMLA动力学对滤波后速度的非理想实现，利用关节速度跟踪误差的实测界对CBF不等式进行收紧处理。本文在作业空间、执行器限制和物理交互等场景下，对四种配置——即VDC、VIC+VDC、CBF+VDC及VIC+CBF+VDC——进行了评估。结果表明，VIC可将环境交互力的峰值和均方根值分别降低92.59%和96.33%；两种鲁棒CBF配置均能保持正向的作业空间和EMLA安全裕度，而VIC+CBF+VDC相比CBF+VDC，其CBF干预指标减少了10.30%。

Authors: Amir Hossein Barjini, Mohammad Bahari, Jouni Mattila

BoBDeLaN: Bounded-Bandwidth Context Adaptation for Deep Lagrangian Robot Control Manipulation

Deep Lagrangian Networks Recurrent Equilibrium Network Model Predictive Control Disturbance Sensitivity Context Adaptation

简要说明：BoBDeLaN为深度拉格朗日网络引入了一种有界带宽上下文编码器，通过收缩循环均衡网络和线性滤波降低机器人控制中的扰动敏感性，在真实硬件上展示了更优的预测和更平滑的运动。

TLDR: BoBDeLaN introduces a bounded-bandwidth context encoder for Deep Lagrangian Networks, using a contracting Recurrent Equilibrium Network and linear filtering to reduce disturbance sensitivity in robot control, demonstrating improved prediction and smoother motion on real hardware.

Abstract: Learned physics-based models provide structure for robot control, but uncertain payloads and unmodeled dynamics limit their predictive accuracy. Context-aware Deep Lagrangian Networks enable adaptation through a latent context inferred from measurement histories while retaining Lagrangian structure for each fixed context. However, this structure alone does not constrain sensitivity to measurement disturbances. We introduce BoBDeLaN, which combines a contracting, gain-bounded Recurrent Equilibrium Network context encoder with stable linear filtering to shape disturbance sensitivity across frequencies. This architecture guarantees exponential forgetting of the recurrent initialization and admits a finite-horizon, frequency-weighted bound on context perturbations, which extends to residual torque prediction under a Lipschitz continuity assumption on the context-conditioned dynamics model. We evaluate a low-pass realization within model predictive control on simulated and real hardware manipulation tasks, together with frequency-sensitivity analysis on real-robot data. Compared with an LSTM encoder using the same input filter, BoBDeLaN exhibits reduced high-frequency context sensitivity, lower residual torque prediction error, and smoother motion, with less degradation under injected disturbances.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的物理模型为机器人控制提供了结构支撑，但不确定的负载和未建模的动力学限制了其预测精度。上下文感知的深度拉格朗日网络通过从测量历史中推断潜在上下文实现自适应，同时在每个固定上下文下保持拉格朗日结构。然而，仅靠这种结构无法约束对测量扰动的敏感性。我们提出BoBDeLaN，它将具有收缩性、增益有界的递归均衡网络上下文编码器与稳定的线性滤波相结合，以跨频率塑造扰动敏感性。该架构保证了对递归初始化的指数遗忘，并允许对上下文扰动施加有限时域、频率加权的界，该界在上下文条件动力学模型的Lipschitz连续性假设下可推广至残余扭矩预测。我们在仿真和真实硬件操作任务中评估了模型预测控制内的低通实现，并在真实机器人数据上进行了频率敏感性分析。与使用相同输入滤波器的LSTM编码器相比，BoBDeLaN表现出更低的上下文高频敏感性、更低的残余扭矩预测误差和更平滑的运动，且在注入扰动下性能退化更小。

Authors: Lucas Schulze, Sucheth Shenoy, Jan Peters, Oleg Arenz

ReuseMem: One Memory, Multiple Goals in Robot Manipulation Manipulation

visual memory robot manipulation memory retrieval action interface multi-goal

简要说明：ReuseMem 提出一种机器人操作记忆系统，将视觉特征一次性存储并复用于多个下游目标，通过专家动作预测监督记忆选择，在仿真和实物场景中提升了联合目标完成率。

TLDR: ReuseMem introduces a robot manipulation memory system that stores visual features once and reuses them for multiple downstream goals, supervised by expert-action prediction to select relevant memory evidence and show improvements in simulation and physical scenarios.

Abstract: Robots that work alongside people should be able to use what they have seen when new requests arise. The same experience may later support identifying an object or returning it to its original location, although these uses were unknown during observation. ReuseMem learns to use one visual memory for multiple later manipulation goals. It records visual features independently of future goals, retrieves complementary evidence for each request, and combines it with the current scene through a lightweight action interface. Retrieval is supervised by how well candidate evidence supports expert-action prediction across different current states, linking memory selection to its use in manipulation. Repeated visual features are stored once, and memory computations that remain unchanged during action generation are reused. Experiments on four simulation tasks and two physical scenarios demonstrate reuse of a common recording across different requests. With matched action adaptation, ReuseMem improves joint goal completion on the benchmark tasks by 24.5 percentage points over uniform memory. These findings show that one memory can support multiple later manipulation goals as the scene changes.

摘要（中文）：与人类协作的机器人应当能够在面临新请求时，运用此前所见的信息。同样的经验可能日后用于识别物体或将其放回原位，尽管这些用途在观察时并未预知。ReuseMem学会将单一视觉记忆用于多种后续操作目标。它记录与未来目标无关的视觉特征，针对每个请求检索互补证据，并通过轻量级动作接口将其与当前场景结合。检索过程以候选证据在不同当前状态下对专家动作预测的支持程度为监督信号，将记忆选择与其在操作中的实际用途相联系。重复出现的视觉特征仅存储一次，而在动作生成过程中保持不变的内存计算则被复用。在四项仿真任务和两项物理场景中的实验表明，同一记录可被不同请求复用。在动作适配条件一致的情况下，ReuseMem在基准任务上的联合目标完成率较均匀记忆方式提升了24.5个百分点。这些发现表明，同一记忆可在场景变化中支持多种后续操作目标。
