Authors: Yoonseok Kang, Dayeon Jung, Seunghoon Jeon, Wonjib Kim, Dongchul Park

Multi-CONDOR: Learning Multistable Motion Primitives from Demonstration Manipulation

Motion Primitives Imitation Learning Dynamical Systems Stability Grasping

简要说明：本文提出multi-CONDOR，一种基于动态系统的运动基元学习框架，支持多个离散吸引子或连续目标轮廓，用于机器人操作，在仿真和真实Franka机器人上展示了更高的任务成功率和精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces multi-CONDOR, a dynamical-system-based framework that learns motion primitives with multiple discrete attractors or continuous goal contours for robotic manipulation, demonstrating improved task success and accuracy in simulation and on a real Franka robot.

Abstract: Dynamical-system-based motion policies provide a framework for learning reactive robot motions with stability and convergence properties. Many manipulation tasks, however, admit several distinct goals or a continuous set of acceptable outcomes, requiring motion primitives that preserve these alternatives. Accommodating both goal structures within a unified framework with continuous, autonomous dynamics remains an open challenge. We propose a CONDOR-based framework, multi-CONDOR, for learning motion primitives with either multiple discrete attractors or a continuous attracting goal contour. The approach combines imitation learning with losses that encourage agreement between the learned task dynamics and latent reference systems encoding the desired attraction structure. We provide a Lyapunov-based analysis of the convergence properties of the learned motion dynamics. We evaluate the framework on simulated benchmarks with discrete goals, qualitative examples with continuous goal contours, and robotic grasping experiments. In simulation, multi-CONDOR reduces trajectory RMSE by approximately 72% compared with separately learned single-goal motion primitives selected by a state machine. For tasks with two and three goals, respectively, it reduces the fraction of evaluated initial states ending outside the goal tolerance from StableNODE's 0.31% and 7.29% to 0% in both settings. Experiments with a Franka Emika robot arm demonstrate successful grasping of a container by either of its two handles using motions learned from demonstrations. Together, these results show multi-CONDOR combines motion reproduction with the flexibility to converge to alternative valid outcomes.

摘要（中文）：基于动力系统的运动策略为学习具有稳定性和收敛特性的反应式机器人运动提供了一个框架。然而，许多操作任务允许多个不同目标或一组连续可接受的结果，这就需要保留这些备选方案的运动原语。如何在统一框架内同时容纳这两种目标结构，并保持连续、自主的动力系统，仍是一个开放性的挑战。我们提出了一种基于CONDOR的框架，称为multi-CONDOR，用于学习具有多个离散吸引子或连续吸引目标轮廓的运动原语。该方法将模仿学习与损失函数相结合，以促进所学任务动力学与编码期望吸引结构的潜在参考系统之间的一致性。我们提供了基于Lyapunov的分析，以验证所学运动动力学的收敛特性。我们在具有离散目标的模拟基准、具有连续目标轮廓的定性示例以及机器人抓取实验中对该框架进行了评估。在仿真中，与通过状态机选择的单独学习的单目标运动原语相比，multi-CONDOR将轨迹均方根误差降低了约72%。对于分别具有两个和三个目标的任务，它将评估初始状态中落在目标容差之外的比例从StableNODE的0.31%和7.29%均降至0%。使用Franka Emika机械臂的实验表明，利用从演示中学习的运动，可以通过容器的两个把手中的任意一个成功抓取容器。综上，这些结果表明multi-CONDOR将运动复现与收敛至替代有效结果的灵活性结合了起来。

Authors: Gabriele Giuseppe Di Marzo, Mariano Ramírez Montero, Maximilian Stölzle, Rodrigo Pérez-Dattari, Cosimo Della Santina

FlowRow: Learning Navigation Behaviors in Agricultural Environments with Long-Horizon Goal-Conditioned Flow Matching Policies VLA

flow matching goal-conditioned navigation agricultural robotics local planning embodied AI

简要说明：FlowRow提出了一种基于流匹配的局部规划器，用于农业环境中的长时程目标条件导航，在一个包含900个场景的新基准（RowNavBench）中，成功率显著高于基线。

TLDR: FlowRow introduces a flow-matching-based local planner for long-horizon goal-conditioned navigation in agricultural environments, achieving significantly higher success rates than baselines in a new benchmark (RowNavBench) with 900 episodes in Isaac Sim.

Abstract: Autonomous monitoring and intervention in semi-structured agricultural environments, such as orchards and vineyards, require mobile robots to navigate to locations across diverse field configurations. This entails performing navigation behaviors including in-row driving, row turning and skipping, and inter-row traversal. Recent learning-based approaches have enabled robust in-row navigation from onboard perception, but navigation across rows typically requires a priori knowledge of field geometry to specify and tune row-transition maneuvers, preventing arbitrary transitions between rows. We address this challenge by framing navigation in these environments as a goal-directed navigation task, where a long-horizon goal is expressed relative to the robot and a planner generates local paths based on the goal and the robot's perceptual observations. We present FlowRow, a flow-matching-based local planner which models the distribution of diverse agricultural navigation behaviors as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ paths using the long-horizon goal and depth perception. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce RowNavBench, a navigation benchmark for semi-structured agricultural environments developed in Isaac Sim, comprising 900 episodes across grape vineyards, lemon orchards, and apple orchards with varying row lengths, row and plant spacings, plant positions, and weed growth. FlowRow achieves 87% success, compared to 44% for the strongest generative behavior cloning baseline retrained on the same demonstrations. We will release our benchmark, data, and code upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：自主监测与干预半结构化农业环境（如果园和葡萄园）要求移动机器人能够穿越多种田间布局并导航至目标位置。这涉及执行一系列导航行为，包括行内行驶、行末转向与跳行，以及跨行穿行。近年来基于学习的方法已使机器人能够凭借机载感知实现稳健的行内导航，但跨行导航通常需要预先获取田间几何信息，以指定和调整行间转换操作，从而限制了机器人任意切换行间的能力。为解决这一挑战，我们将此类环境中的导航问题重构为目标导向的导航任务：长时程目标以机器人自身为参照系进行表达，规划器则基于该目标及机器人感知观测生成局部路径。我们提出FlowRow，一种基于流匹配的局部规划器，利用长时程目标与深度感知信息，将多样化的农业导航行为分布建模为$\mathrm{SE}(2)$路径。为实现系统性评估，我们引入RowNavBench——一个基于Isaac Sim构建的半结构化农业环境导航基准，涵盖葡萄园、柠檬园和苹果园共900个测试场景，并变化行距、株距、植株位置及杂草生长条件。FlowRow在测试中达到87%的成功率，而基于相同示教数据重新训练的最强生成式行为克隆基线仅为44%。我们将在论文被接收后发布基准、数据及代码。

Authors: Utkarsh Bajpai, Cédric Pradalier, Stéphanie Aravecchia

ROSE: A Shared Cross-Embodiment Facial-Motion Latent Space for Humanoid Robot Expression HumanoidEmbodied

cross-embodiment latent space facial expression generation humanoid robot hardware multimodal motion generation actuator control

简要说明：ROSE 提出了一个包含34个执行器的仿人机器人头部和共享面部运动潜在空间，支持多模态（文本/音频）表情生成和真机控制，无需视频重定向。

TLDR: ROSE introduces a biomimetic humanoid head with 34 actuators and a shared facial-motion latent space, enabling multimodal (text/audio) expression generation and physical robot control without video retargeting.

Abstract: Natural, coherent full-face dynamic expressions are central to making humanoid robots socially approachable, yet existing systems commonly realize only limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The limitation is both physical and algorithmic. A compact head leaves little room for densely packed, independently controllable actuation; meanwhile, learned systems often generate an avatar video, landmarks, or facial parameters and then infer actuator commands through visual retargeting. This render-and-invert path adds latency and artifacts, and it does not reliably transfer generated behavior to a physical robot. We present ROSE (RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings), a framework that integrates biomimetic hardware, cross-embodiment motion representation learning, and multimodal motion generation. On the hardware side, we build a flexible tendon-sheath transmission structure that integrates 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm biomimetic head. By decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, it enables coordinated full-face expression within a compact volume. On the algorithmic side, ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent space from human, digital-human, and robot observations. ROSE-Flow directly maps text, audio, or their combination to trajectories in this motion space without using video as a generator input. ROSE-ACT then converts these trajectories into constrained actuator commands. Our system demonstrates how high-density biomimetic hardware and a shared executable facial-motion representation can jointly unify cross-embodiment learning, multimodal generation, and physical robot expression.

摘要（中文）：自然、连贯的全脸动态表情对于使仿人机器人具有社交亲和力至关重要，然而现有系统通常仅能实现有限的唇部运动或脚本化表情。这一局限性既源于物理层面，也源于算法层面。紧凑的头部结构难以容纳密集布置、可独立控制的驱动单元；同时，基于学习的系统通常生成虚拟形象视频、关键点或面部参数，再通过视觉重定向推断驱动指令。这种“渲染-反演”路径引入了延迟和伪影，并且无法可靠地将生成的行为迁移至实体机器人。我们提出ROSE（共享运动嵌入的机器人面部表情框架），该框架整合了仿生硬件、跨实体运动表示学习以及多模态运动生成。在硬件方面，我们构建了灵活的腱鞘传动结构，将34个驱动器集成于19.5厘米的仿生头骨中。通过将驱动器布置与面部动作点解耦，该系统能够在紧凑体积内实现协调的全脸表情。在算法方面，ROSE-VAE从人类、数字人类和机器人观测中学习与身份无关的共享面部运动潜空间。ROSE-Flow直接将文本、音频或其组合映射至该运动空间中的轨迹，而无需以视频作为生成器输入。ROSE-ACT随后将这些轨迹转换为受约束的驱动器指令。我们的系统展示了高密度仿生硬件与可执行的共享面部运动表示如何共同统一跨实体学习、多模态生成以及实体机器人表情表达。

Authors: Yongji Fu, Man Cao, Yi Zhou, Fei Lin, Mark F. Hansen, Guanqun Cao

MVSTF: Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based Moving Object Segmentation Perception3D

moving object segmentation multi-view fusion spatio-temporal features LiDAR point clouds autonomous driving

简要说明：MVSTF是一种基于激光雷达的移动物体分割的端到端多视角时空融合网络，利用连续点云生成多视角图像和特征差异，在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-Road基准上取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: MVSTF is an end-to-end multi-view spatio-temporal fusion network for LiDAR-based moving object segmentation, using sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and achieving state-of-the-art results on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road benchmarks.

Abstract: Autonomous mobile robots confront significant chal lenges in recognizing the motion properties of objects in dy namic environments. However, existing methods are hindered by limitations such as boundary ambiguity, occlusion, viewpoint constraints, and training complexity. In this paper, we propose an innovative end-to-end Multi-View Spatio-Temporal Fusion network, named MVSTF, which utilizes sequential point clouds to generate multi-view images and feature differences, and designs a multi-branch network to extract spatio-temporal and dimen sional features in parallel, and realizes high-precision moving object segmentation. First, sequential point clouds are utilized to generate multi-view images and feature differences. Then, an end-to-end multi-branch network including Dual Down-sampling Blocks (DDB), Spatial Attention Blocks (SAB), Multi-Kernel Convolutional Neural Network blocks (MKCNN), Dual Feature Fusion Blocks (DFFB), and the Point Fusion (PF) module, is designed to extract motion features from feature differences and geometric and semantic features from multi-view images. Finally, an auxiliary semantic head is introduced to further improve the algorithm's robustness and the model's interpretability. This work is validated on the SemanticKITTI and KITTI-Road bench marks, achieving state-of-the-art results on the SemanticKITTI MOS validation set and the KITTI-Road validation set, and competitive results on the hidden SemanticKITTI-MOS test set. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhouJJ111/MVSTF.

摘要（中文）：自主移动机器人在动态环境中识别物体运动属性时面临重大挑战。然而，现有方法受限于边界模糊、遮挡、视角约束及训练复杂度等问题。本文提出了一种创新的端到端多视图时空融合网络，命名为MVSTF，利用序列点云生成多视图图像及特征差异，并设计多分支网络并行提取时空特征与维度特征，实现高精度的运动物体分割。首先，利用序列点云生成多视图图像及特征差异；随后，设计包含双下采样模块（DDB）、空间注意力模块（SAB）、多核卷积神经网络模块（MKCNN）、双特征融合模块（DFFB）及点融合（PF）模块的端到端多分支网络，从特征差异中提取运动特征，并从多视图图像中提取几何特征与语义特征；最后，引入辅助语义头以进一步提升算法的鲁棒性与模型的可解释性。该方法在SemanticKITTI和KITTI-Road基准上进行了验证，在SemanticKITTI MOS验证集和KITTI-Road验证集上取得了最优结果，并在隐藏的SemanticKITTI-MOS测试集上取得了具有竞争力的结果。代码已开源，见https://github.com/ZhouJJ111/MVSTF。

Authors: Jiaoju Zhou, Chao Ye, Xuebo Yang, Weiyang Lin

STA: A Split Temporal Adversary Method for Evaluating Robustness of Multimodal RL-based Driving Policies AutonomousDriving

adversarial attack temporal robustness multimodal reinforcement learning autonomous driving CARLA

简要说明：本文提出STA，一种统一对抗攻击框架，联合优化攻击时机和模态选择以诱导多模态RL驾驶策略的时序错位，揭示时序一致性是驾驶安全的关键薄弱点。

TLDR: The paper introduces STA, a unified adversarial attack framework that jointly optimizes timing and modality selection to induce temporal misalignment in multimodal RL driving policies, revealing temporal consistency as a critical safety vulnerability in driving.

Abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning (MRL) offers a promising paradigm for autonomous driving by jointly leveraging complementary sensor observations to learn effective decision-making policies. However, its effectiveness critically depends on temporal alignment across modalities, making temporal inconsistency a fundamental vulnerability. Even subtle misalignment or latency can corrupt fused representations and ultimately lead to decision failures. Existing studies have explored adversarial attacks to induce cross-modal temporal inconsistencies, thereby enabling systematic evaluation of the temporal robustness of MRL policies. However, existing methods remain limited in generality, realism, and adaptivity. To address these limitations, we propose the Split Temporal Adversary (STA), which formulates multimodal temporal attacks as a unified decision process that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection under realistic policy-aware and budget-constrained settings. STA includes two mechanisms: a) a unified multimodal temporal perturbation mechanism that delays observations via historical states, removing the need for modality-specific noise; b) a split multimodal adversarial decision mechanism that jointly optimizes attack timing and modality selection through adaptive optimization while leveraging the victim policy's clean actions to identify sensitive decision patterns. We provide a theoretical analysis of the induced distribution shift and a modality selection principle. Experiments in the CARLA simulator show that STA more than doubles the collision rate of the strongest baseline against PPO while using 17.8\% fewer attack attempts, and that it generalizes to a VLM-based driving policy. These results reveal temporal consistency as a critical vulnerability, highlighting temporal robustness as essential for safe autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：多模态强化学习（MRL）为自动驾驶提供了一种有前景的范式，通过联合利用互补的传感器观测来学习有效的决策策略。然而，其有效性在很大程度上依赖于跨模态的时间对齐，这使得时间不一致性成为一个根本性的脆弱点。即使是细微的错位或延迟也可能破坏融合表示，并最终导致决策失败。已有研究探索了对抗性攻击以诱发跨模态时间不一致性，从而能够系统评估MRL策略的时间鲁棒性。然而，现有方法在通用性、真实性和自适应性方面仍存在局限。为解决这些不足，我们提出了分裂时间对抗器（STA），将多模态时间攻击形式化为一个统一的决策过程，在基于策略感知和预算约束的现实设置下联合优化攻击时机与模态选择。STA包含两种机制：a) 一种统一的多模态时间扰动机制，通过历史状态延迟观测，无需针对特定模态的噪声；b) 一种分裂式多模态对抗决策机制，通过自适应优化联合优化攻击时机与模态选择，同时利用受害策略的清洁动作来识别敏感的决策模式。我们对由此引发的分布偏移提供了理论分析，并提出了一种模态选择原则。在CARLA模拟器中的实验表明，STA将最强基线针对PPO的碰撞率提升了一倍以上，同时攻击尝试次数减少了17.8%，并且该方法能够泛化至基于VLM的驾驶策略。这些结果揭示了时间一致性是一个关键脆弱点，凸显了时间鲁棒性对于安全自动驾驶的必要性。

Authors: Shenghao Xiong, Xiaolin Chang

Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era Other

robotic reward models foundation models reward engineering task-conditioned evaluation closed-loop executions

简要说明：本综述将114种机器人奖励模型方法按其输出问题划分为五个语义家族，提出了包含1,117个真实机器人视频的RRM-Bench-1K基准及四个对照套件，并对27个评估器进行了统一研究，发现密集信用跟踪执行时间顺序而非任务状态，同时开源了RRM-Hub工具箱。

TLDR: This survey organizes 114 robotic reward model (RRM) methods into five semantic families based on their output question, introduces RRM-Bench-1K, a 1,117 real-robot video benchmark with four contrast suites, and presents a unified study of 27 evaluators revealing that dense credit tracks execution chronology rather than task state, alongside the open-source RRM-Hub toolbox.

Abstract: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.

摘要（中文）：机器人奖励模型（RRMs）利用基础模型，以可复用的、任务条件化的评估方式取代逐任务奖励工程。然而，在同一个名称之下，其输出所回答的问题各不相同——从任务是否成功到哪种执行更优。本综述依据模型原生输出所回答的问题，将114种方法划分为五个语义族：结果型、绝对进展型、相对型、时间价值型和混合型。在此分类框架下，我们审视了模型设计如何决定评估器能判断什么、原始经验如何转化为监督信号，以及现有评估实践如何检验其结果。综述揭示了一个空白：与演示顺序的一致性以及下游策略增益，并不能证明奖励是否追踪了任务完成状态。因此，我们引入了RRM-Bench-1K——包含1117段闭环执行的真实机器人视频，带有任务状态和相机证据标签——以及四组对比套件，用于将受信条件与其常见线索区分开来。一项针对27个评估器的统一研究表明，最强的最终得分能够足够好地对整体执行进行排序，以支持选择和筛选。然而，密集信用分配更多遵循执行的进展过程而非其任务状态，并且当决定性视角缺失时，没有任何评估器能发出信号。因此，奖励模型需要多高的保真度取决于其驱动的决策。我们概述了从真实失败监督到将任务状态与时间顺序分离的度量指标的若干方向，并开源了RRM-Hub工具库，其中14种现有RRM可即取即用，新评估器可在相同能力维度上进行测试。

Authors: Guoqiang Liang, Yiqi Lin, Shangchen Zhou, Wenzheng Zeng, Yanzhe Chen, Zechen Bai, Mike Zheng Shou

SG-ODOM: Event-Driven Proprioceptive State Estimation with Stability-Gated Contact Updates for Legged Robots Locomotion

proprioceptive state estimation stability-gated contact selection legged robots odometry contact scheduling

简要说明：SG-ODOM 提出了一种针对腿式机器人的本体感觉里程计框架，通过稳定性门控接触选择来安排运动学更新，在户外序列上将相对位姿误差最多降低 25%。

TLDR: SG-ODOM presents a proprioceptive odometry framework for legged robots that uses stability-gated contact selection to schedule kinematic updates, improving state estimation accuracy by up to 25% RPE on outdoor sequences.

Abstract: Reliable proprioceptive state estimation for legged robots fuses inertial sensing with kinematic sensing from leg encoders. The latter assumes a foot is stationary during the stance phase; however, physical foot touchdown does not necessarily provide a stationary reference for odometry, particularly during impact and load transfer. Repeatedly applying kinematic corrections throughout the same contact phase can introduce redundant or unreliable information. We present SG-ODOM, a proprioceptive odometry framework that uses stability-gated contact selection to schedule kinematic updates. Following physical touchdown, a stability gate accepts the contact for state estimation only after the foot reaches a sufficiently stable support condition. The resulting validated touchdown event triggers an estimator correction, while additional timeout updates bound the maximum duration of uninterrupted IMU propagation. The framework is evaluated on multiple legged platforms, both quadrupedal and humanoid robots, against representative state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators. Across the evaluated sequences, SG-ODOM demonstrates competitive or superior estimation accuracy, reducing Relative Pose Error (RPE) by up to 25% compared to the baseline estimator on outdoor sequences from the GrandTour dataset. Source code: https://github.com/ori-drs/SG-ODOM. Video: https://youtu.be/-583_RyuhqQ

摘要（中文）：摘要：可靠的腿式机器人本体感觉状态估计融合了惯性传感与腿部编码器的运动学传感。后者假设脚在支撑阶段保持静止；然而，物理上的脚掌触地并不一定能为里程计提供静止参考，尤其在冲击和载荷转移期间。在整个接触阶段反复应用运动学修正可能会引入冗余或不可靠的信息。我们提出了SG-ODOM，一种使用稳定性门控接触选择来调度运动学更新的本体感觉里程计框架。在物理触地之后，稳定性门仅在脚达到足够稳定的支撑条件时才接受该接触用于状态估计。由此产生的经过验证的触地事件触发估计器修正，而额外的超时更新则限制了IMU连续传播的最大持续时间。该框架在多个腿式平台（包括四足机器人和人形机器人）上进行了评估，并与具有代表性的最新本体感觉估计器进行了对比。在评估的序列中，SG-ODOM展现出具有竞争力或更优的估计精度，在GrandTour数据集的室外序列中，相较于基线估计器，相对位姿误差（RPE）最多降低了25%。源代码：https://github.com/ori-drs/SG-ODOM。视频：https://youtu.be/-583_RyuhqQ

Authors: Francesco Iotti, Chiyun Noh, Franco Angelini, Manolo Garabini, Ayoung Kim, Maurice Fallon, Frank Dellaert

Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation VLN

vision-language navigation closed-loop progress verification agentic long-horizon

简要说明：LeaP-VLN 提出了一种用于长时程视觉语言导航的闭环智能体系统，将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相结合，在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 基准上取得了最先进的成功率。

TLDR: LeaP-VLN introduces a closed-loop agentic system for long-horizon vision-language navigation that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

Abstract: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.

摘要（中文）：长视野视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体跟踪指令进度，并在局部错误跨子任务传播之前予以纠正。然而，基于专家轨迹训练的執行器在部署过程中会遭遇策略诱导的状态偏移，且其停止信号无法可靠地指示子任务是否完成。我们提出了面向VLN的学习与验证进度方法（LeaP-VLN），这是一种智能体式VLN系统，通过“规划—执行—验证—恢复”循环，将进度感知执行与独立进度验证相结合。LeaP-VLN在显式层面利用进度：通过进度验证器在智能体推进前验证子任务完成情况，并在路线偏离时触发双阶段恢复机制；在隐式层面，通过联合训练执行器的进度推理与动作预测，增强其对进度的感知能力和纠错控制能力。为使执行器适应这一闭环接口，我们提出了一种两阶段进度增强课程：先在专家演示上进行行为克隆，再在演示、专家动作修正和进度推理监督上联合训练。策略生成的轨迹使执行器同时暴露于子任务内漂移和子任务间状态偏移，从而使训练与闭环执行中遇到的偏差保持一致。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中，LeaP-VLN取得了最优的成功率；同时，真实世界实验进一步验证了LeaP-VLN在长视野导航中的有效性。

Authors: Kangjie Zhou, Sukai Wang, Yuhan Xiao, Qinghang Liu, Zhejia Wen, ChunXuan Jiao, Wei Shan, Guanghui Ren, Maoqing Yao, Chang Liu

Stability Principle Inherent in Wheel Gait of Planar X-shaped Walker Generated Using Constant Torque Drive and Mechanical Stoppers Locomotion

passive dynamic walking limit-cycle walker mechanical stoppers wheel gait gait stability

简要说明：本文分析了一种带有髋部机械限位器的平面X形步行器在恒定扭矩驱动下的稳定性，推导了近似解析误差传递函数，并通过数值模拟证明了整体的渐近稳定性。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the stability of a planar X-shaped walker with hip mechanical stoppers under constant torque drive, deriving approximate analytical error transition functions and demonstrating overall asymptotic stability through numerical simulations.

Abstract: Since the late 19th century when the first walking toys were developed, it has been known that mechanical stoppers at the hip joint are crucial for generating stable passive dynamic walking. Recent research on passive-dynamic and limit-cycle walkers has also confirmed that mechanical stoppers at the hip and knee joints are effective for generating stable walking motion, but theoretical research on how this mechanical constraint enhances the overall gait stability remains insufficient. This paper introduces a planar X-shaped walker equipped with mechanical stoppers at the hip joint, and investigates the effect of the mechanical constraint on the stability of the wheel gait generated by constant torque drive on a downslope. By simply falling forward while using the stoppers to constrain itself to the target impact posture, the robot can generate a highly stable wheel gait. We divide the motion of one step into four phases, derive approximate analytical solutions for the state error transition function matrix in each phase using a linearized model, and analyze the increase or decrease in the state error norm using metrics such as its maximum singular value. Numerical simulations demonstrate that while two phases are unstable in terms of the increase in the state error norm, the remaining two phases are stable, resulting in overall asymptotic stability.

摘要（中文）：自19世纪末首批步行玩具问世以来，人们便已知髋关节处的机械限位装置对于产生稳定的被动动态行走至关重要。近期关于被动动态行走器及极限环行走器的研究也证实，髋关节和膝关节处的机械限位装置能有效产生稳定的行走运动，然而关于这种机械约束如何增强整体步态稳定性的理论研究仍显不足。本文介绍了一种平面X形行走器，其髋关节处装有机械限位装置，并研究了该机械约束对在斜坡上由恒定力矩驱动所产生的轮式步态稳定性的影响。通过仅向前倾倒并利用限位装置将自身约束至目标撞击姿态，该机器人能够产生高度稳定的轮式步态。我们将一步运动划分为四个阶段，利用线性化模型推导各阶段状态误差转移函数矩阵的近似解析解，并通过最大奇异值等指标分析状态误差范数的增减情况。数值仿真表明，尽管其中两个阶段在状态误差范数增长方面是不稳定的，但其余两个阶段是稳定的，从而整体上实现了渐近稳定性。

Authors: Fumihiko Asano, Cong Yan

Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots VLN

vision-language navigation open-vocabulary detection semantic mapping ROS2 Gazebo simulation

简要说明：该论文提出一个基于ROS2的系统，结合开放词汇目标检测（Grounding DINO）、前沿探索和Nav2导航，在Gazebo仿真中实现移动机器人的自然语言接地导航。

TLDR: The paper presents a ROS2-based system integrating open-vocabulary object detection (Grounding DINO) with frontier-based exploration and Nav2 navigation to enable natural language grounded navigation for a mobile robot in Gazebo simulation.

Abstract: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.

摘要（中文）：语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解析自然语言指令，并在非结构化环境中导航至用户指定的目标。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与经典的建图和导航机器人流水线相结合仍是一个具有挑战性的问题。本研究提出了一套完整的基于ROS2的系统，该系统结合了基于前沿的探索、使用Grounding DINO的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的3D定位以及语义建图，从而在仿真环境中实现端到端的视觉-语言接地导航。该系统能够接受诸如“前往黄色箱子”之类的自然语言指令，利用文本提示从RGB图像中检测候选目标，估计其世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由Nav2导航栈执行的导航目标。在基于Gazebo的室内环境中使用TurtleBot3机器人，该系统自主探索了房间，检测到了五个目标物体中的三个，并成功执行了所测试的两条自然语言导航指令，且无需针对特定任务进行训练。结果表明，开放词汇接地模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，尽管性能受到检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差以及探索覆盖不完整的限制。这些发现既凸显了在轻量级、仅CPU架构上部署视觉-语言接地导航系统的可行性，也指出了其当前的局限性。

Authors: Ravindran Vasoor Saravanan, Chittin Varunav Ravi, Madhumita Singh, Thirulok Sundar Mohan Rasu

XMimic and XSoma: Learning Humanoid Motion Tracking and Locomotion in Under a Minute HumanoidEmbodied

motion tracking locomotion world model JAX parallel training

简要说明：本文介绍了XMimic和XSoma，通过多GPU并行训练和使用世界模型，实现不到一分钟的人形机器人运动跟踪和 locomotion 学习。

TLDR: This paper introduces XMimic and XSoma, which accelerate humanoid motion tracking and locomotion learning by parallelizing training across multiple GPUs and using a world model, achieving training times under a minute.

Abstract: We present XMimic and XSoma, which learn humanoid motion tracking and locomotion on rough terrain in under a minute of training. Both follow SuperMimic, which learns a world model of the robot and optimizes the policy with analytic gradients through short rollouts imagined in this model. Existing implementations of this method do not make use of larger GPUs, as every training iteration is a long chain of small GPU operations that run one after another. XMimic and XSoma therefore shorten this chain and run the steps of every iteration at the same time on up to four GPUs. We compile the complete training loop with JAX, including the MuJoCo Warp simulator. For locomotion, XSoma leaves only the dynamics of the robot to the world model and computes everything else exactly, including the terrain height under the feet. It learns with a horizon of one second and without a critic. On four H100 GPUs, XMimic learns to track all 40 LAFAN1 clips with the Unitree G1 in 0.86 minutes, 3.7 times faster than BlinkMimic on one GPU. XSoma reaches the tracking target that Holosoma's tests set for FastSAC in 0.77 minutes, 12.3 times faster than FastSAC on one GPU, while needing only an eighth of its environment steps.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了XMimic和XSoma，二者能够在不到一分钟的训练时间内学会人形运动跟踪及复杂地形上的行走。两者均遵循SuperMimic的方法，即学习机器人的世界模型，并通过在该模型中进行的短滚动预测，利用解析梯度对策略进行优化。该方法的现有实现未能充分利用更大规模的GPU，因为每次训练迭代都是由一系列串行执行的小型GPU操作组成的长链。为此，XMimic和XSoma缩短了这一链条，并最多在四块GPU上同时执行每次迭代的步骤。我们使用JAX编译了完整的训练循环，包括MuJoCo Warp模拟器。在行走任务中，XSoma仅将机器人的动力学部分交给世界模型处理，而其余所有计算均精确完成，包括脚下地形高度。它以一秒的预测时域进行学习，且无需评论员网络。在四块H100 GPU上，XMimic在0.86分钟内学会了Unitree G1跟踪全部40个LAFAN1片段，比在单块GPU上的BlinkMimic快3.7倍。XSoma在0.77分钟内达到了Holosoma测试为FastSAC设定的跟踪目标，比单块GPU上的FastSAC快12.3倍，同时仅需其八分之一的环境交互步数。

Authors: Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters

High-Speed Forward and Reverse Tractor-Trailer Driving with Learned Vehicle Dynamics AutonomousDriving

tractor-trailer learned dynamics model MPPI vehicle control hitch angle

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于高速前进和倒车的牵引车-挂车控制的学习型车辆动力学模型，并将其与MPPI控制器集成，在仿真中展示了优于基于Fiala轮胎解析模型的基线控制器的跟踪性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a learned vehicle dynamics model for high-speed forward and reverse tractor-trailer control, integrated with an MPPI controller, and demonstrates superior tracking performance over an analytic Fiala tire model baseline in simulation.

Abstract: Tractor-trailer systems are difficult to control, especially unstable during reverse motion, and their dynamics depend on difficult-to-measure factors, including road friction and suspension coefficients. We introduce a learned dynamics model for tractor-trailer control and compare it with a reduced-order dynamics model with Fiala tire forces as an analytic baseline. Specifically, we compare a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller that uses the learned dynamics model to an MPPI controller that uses the analytic model, as well as to three additional baseline controllers. In the main closed-loop tracking experiments across four simulated environments, MPPI with learned dynamics achieves mean speeds closer to the target magnitudes and lower root-mean-square (RMS) hitch angles than MPPI with the analytic model at every tested setpoint, with higher completion rates in seven of eight reverse configurations.

摘要（中文）：拖拉机-拖车系统控制难度大，尤其在倒车运动中稳定性差，且其动力学特性依赖于难以测量的因素，如道路摩擦系数和悬架系数。我们引入了一种用于拖拉机-拖车控制的学习动力学模型，并将其与基于Fiala轮胎力的降阶动力学模型作为解析基线进行比较。具体而言，我们将使用学习动力学模型的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器与使用解析模型的MPPI控制器，以及另外三种基线控制器进行了对比。在四个模拟环境中的主要闭环跟踪实验中，使用学习动力学模型的MPPI在每个测试设定点均实现了更接近目标速度的平均速度，并且相比使用解析模型的MPPI，具有更低的均方根（RMS）挂接角；在八种倒车构型中，有七种的完成率更高。

Authors: Aaron Chen, David Shen, Taekyung Kim, Kaleb Ben Naveed, Dimitra Panagou

RoboKit: Accelerating Parallel Differentiable Optimization for Robot Learning RLRobot

GPU-parallel optimization differentiable simulation policy distillation reinforcement learning grasping

简要说明：RoboKit 是一个用于机器人的高性能 GPU 并行可微优化工具包，支持快速多种子求解器、可微几何/渲染/仿真，并可无缝集成学习（策略蒸馏和强化学习），在七项任务中展示加速效果。

TLDR: RoboKit is a high-performance GPU-parallel differentiable optimization toolkit for robotics, enabling fast multi-seed solvers, differentiable geometry/rendering/simulation, and seamless integration with learning to distill policies or train RL agents, with demonstrated speedups across seven tasks.

Abstract: We present RoboKit, a high-performance, general-purpose toolkit for parallel differentiable optimization in robotics, built on three principles: (i) Performance and flexibility: GPU-parallel multi-seed solvers pair sampling with versatile optimizers, running 2-60$\times$ faster than task-specific baselines across seven tasks; (ii) Geometry, rendering and physics: hybrid and coarse-to-fine representations accelerate collision, differentiable rendering and simulation, optimizing 4096 grasps in 2.97 s; (iii) Integration with learning: costs are differentiable and simulation is parallel, so RoboKit both distills optimization into policies and trains RL; distilled policies run 9-240$\times$ faster at comparable accuracy, and RL reaches a GPU baseline's scores up to 2.1$\times$ sooner on the same simulator.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍了RoboKit，一个面向机器人学中并行可微分优化的高性能通用工具包，其构建基于三项原则：（i）性能与灵活性：GPU并行的多种子求解器将采样与多功能优化器相结合，在七项任务上比任务特定基线快2-60倍；（ii）几何、渲染与物理：混合及由粗到细的表示方法加速了碰撞检测、可微分渲染与仿真，在2.97秒内优化4096个抓取动作；（iii）与学习的集成：成本函数可微分且仿真并行，因此RoboKit既能将优化结果蒸馏为策略，也能训练强化学习模型；蒸馏后的策略在相当精度下运行速度快9-240倍，而强化学习在同一仿真器上达到GPU基线分数所需时间最多缩短2.1倍。

Authors: Jianglong Ye, Xuanbin Peng, Conor Mc Gartoll, Changwei Jing, Lai Wei, Jiali Chen, Xueyan Zou, Xiaolong Wang

Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits VLN

persistent spatial memory embodied agents video understanding benchmark room association

简要说明：ReSpaceBench 是一个用于评估具身智能体在重复访问中持久空间记忆的基准，结果显示当前视频理解模型和智能体框架在房间关联和记忆更新方面存在困难，而微调可提升准确率。

TLDR: ReSpaceBench is a benchmark for evaluating persistent spatial memory in embodied agents across revisits, showing that current video understanding models and agentic frameworks struggle with room association and memory updating, while fine-tuning on a synthetic dataset improves accuracy.

Abstract: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

摘要（中文）：持久的空间理解对于具身智能体在反复遇到的環境中可靠运行至关重要。这要求智能体能够在视角变化的情况下识别重新到访的地点，将其与外观相似的房间区分开来，并在环境变化时更新记忆。然而，现有的评估往往将跨多次访问的物理地点身份视为隐含前提。我们提出了ReSpaceBench基准，包含涵盖590个合成及真实家庭场景的3,244个问题，组织为9项任务，涵盖房间关联、持久状态跟踪和下游推理。受控漫游通过物理房间进入来定义访问，并有意加入同类型房间干扰项以及跨会话物体变化。我们对32个模型和3个智能体视频理解框架的评估揭示了显著的局限性：表现最强的零样本模型总体准确率为50.5%，在450个问题的子集上为52.2%，而人类标注者达到90.1%。所评估的智能体框架相较于使用相同基础模型的直接推理并未带来总体提升。对智能体执行轨迹的分析揭示了证据遗漏和错误的跨访问房间关联是主要的失败模式，表明仅靠迭代式证据搜寻并不能确保一致的空间记忆。进一步的分析暴露了识别熟悉房间与确定正确到访房间之间的差距，而标注引导的采样则强调了保留中间访问和过渡的重要性。我们还提供了RS-30K，这是一个独立的训练数据集，来源于合成数据，与基准测试在模板、场景、路线或视频上均无重叠。对Qwen3-VL-8B进行微调后，总体准确率从35.5%提升至60.4%，其中关联任务提升最为显著，且改进延伸到了真实生活场景。

Authors: Henry Zheng, Weibo Gong, Yang Yue, Rui Huang, Yang Zhang, Gao Huang

IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes AutonomousDriving

4D reconstruction driving scenes LiDAR-anchored instance-prior distillation Gaussian positioning

简要说明：IGRecon4D 是一种用于动态驾驶场景的前馈4D重建框架，通过实例先验蒸馏防止交通参与者的语义泄漏，并利用LiDAR锚定的高斯定位减少跨视角几何漂移，在Waymo和nuScenes上提升了重建效果。

TLDR: IGRecon4D is a feed-forward 4D reconstruction framework for dynamic driving scenes that uses instance-prior distillation to prevent semantic leakage of traffic participants and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning to reduce geometric drift across viewpoints, improving reconstruction on Waymo and nuScenes.

Abstract: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

摘要（中文）：前馈式4D驾驶场景重建能够高效建模动态自动驾驶场景，但现有方法存在两种互补的失败模式：交通参与者语义泄漏至静态表示，以及高斯位置跨视角的几何漂移。为此，我们提出\textbf{IGRecon4D}，一种前馈式动态场景重建框架，通过训练阶段的实例先验蒸馏和基于LiDAR锚定的高斯定位来克服上述问题。具体而言，实例级语义分支提供潜在的动态参与者先验，并通过实例-动态一致性约束蒸馏至动态掩膜学习中，以促进对易发生动态-静态泄漏的交通参与者区域的高召回率定位。与此同时，稀疏LiDAR测量指导密集深度估计，所得深度被反投影以锚定高斯位置，从而提升多视角几何一致性。在Waymo开放数据集上的实验以及在nuScenes上的零样本评估表明，本方法在主基准上实现了更优的全图像重建，并在跨数据集评估中展现了更强的交通参与者区域重建能力。

Authors: Yifei Tong, Ziyang Huang, Yizhao Han, Xiaoxiao Long, Hao Zhu

MetricHand: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for 4D Hand Reconstruction in Metric World Space Other

4D hand reconstruction metric world space flow matching depth priors MANO articulation

简要说明：MetricHand 是一个几何感知的流匹配框架，用于在度量世界空间中进行 4D 手部重建，专为灵巧操作和 VLA 预训练提供准确且时间连贯的自我中心手部运动监督而设计。它利用手-物交互区域的深度先验，增强了世界空间定位和时间保真度。

TLDR: MetricHand is a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space, specifically designed to provide accurate and temporally coherent egocentric hand motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and VLA pretraining. It incorporates depth priors from hand-object interactions into joint-associated representations, improving world-space localization and temporal fidelity.

Abstract: Egocentric hand motion provides physical motion supervision for dexterous manipulation and vision-language-action pretraining. Reliable use of this supervision requires accurate and temporally coherent 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. Existing methods typically lift framewise estimates produced under weak perspective into world coordinates. By ignoring joint-dependent depth variation at close range, this approximation couples errors in translation, orientation, and articulation that persist after world lifting and worsen under occlusion. We present MetricHand, a geometry-aware flow matching framework for 4D hand reconstruction in metric world space. MetricHand encodes depth priors from hand-object interaction regions into joint-associated representations that preserve local spatial structure and metric scale. Fused with visual features, this geometry guides coarse metric estimation and conditions every step of temporal generation. The model jointly recovers world-space translation, global orientation, MANO articulation, and shape, while structural priors and temporal context support estimation under partial occlusion. MetricHand reduces camera-space MPJPE by 49.3% and 52.9%, absolute world-space MPJPE by 28.7% and 21.7%, and wrist localization error by 48.5% and 37.9% relative to HaWoR, respectively. World-space acceleration error decreases by 44.2% and 64.3%, demonstrating improved temporal fidelity alongside more accurate absolute localization.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的手部运动为灵巧操作和视觉-语言-动作预训练提供了物理运动监督。要可靠地利用这一监督，需要在度量世界空间中进行精确且时间连贯的四维手部重建。现有方法通常将在弱透视下产生的逐帧估计提升至世界坐标。通过忽略近距离下与关节相关的深度变化，这一近似将平移、方向和关节运动的误差耦合在一起，这些误差在世界坐标提升后仍然存在，并在遮挡情况下进一步恶化。我们提出了MetricHand，一种用于度量世界空间中四维手部重建的几何感知流匹配框架。MetricHand将来自手-物交互区域的深度先验编码为与关节相关的表示，从而保留局部空间结构和度量尺度。与视觉特征融合后，该几何信息引导粗略度量估计，并调节时间生成的每一步。该模型联合恢复世界空间平移、全局方向、MANO关节运动和形状，同时结构先验和时间上下文支持部分遮挡下的估计。与HaWoR相比，MetricHand在相机空间MPJPE上分别降低了49.3%和52.9%，在绝对世界空间MPJPE上分别降低了28.7%和21.7%，手腕定位误差分别降低了48.5%和37.9%。世界空间加速度误差分别降低了44.2%和64.3%，表明在更准确的绝对定位基础上，时间保真度也得到了改善。

Authors: Yibo Bai, Likui Zhang, Jinglei Zhang, Zhengbin Pang, Xingshen Song, Xiaoqing Yin, Jinsheng Deng

UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge 2026: Site-Calibrated Synthetic Data and Multi-Detector Fusion for Roadside 3D Detection Perception3D

synthetic data LiDAR detection sim2real multi-detector fusion CARLA

简要说明：本文提出了一种仅使用针对真实路边传感器站点校准的CARLA合成LiDAR数据训练3D检测器的流程，并提出了多检测器融合方法，在UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR挑战赛中取得了高性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a pipeline for training 3D detectors using only synthetic CARLA LiDAR data calibrated to a real roadside sensor site, and proposes a multi-detector fusion approach that achieves high performance on the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge.

Abstract: This report summarizes the work submitted by team arnav007 (submission ID 1054222) for the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (V2X-Real track) at the IEEE BigData Cup 2026. The primary objective is to train 3D detectors for vehicles, pedestrians, and trucks using only synthetic roadside LiDAR data, and to generate synthetic scans that are realistic enough to be indistinguishable from real ones. A CARLA based pipeline is developed and calibrated to the fixed sensor site, accurately modeling the range image, including no-return beams, based on unlabelled real development scans. A combined inference detector, using multiple 3D detectors (VoxelNeXt, PV-RCNN, and SECOND) trained exclusively on synthetic data, is also proposed. Each scan is aligned to the synthetic ground plane and processed through the detectors at multiple ground heights. The resulting bounding boxes are fused using bird's-eye view (BEV) clustering, followed by class-specific post-processing to refine heading, box size, and filter low-confidence detections. The final submission achieved a combined score of 0.8947. The ablation study shows that per-scan ground leveling more than doubled the real-scan mAP, while fusing boxes across different heights and models further improved performance.

摘要（中文）：本报告总结了团队arnav007（提交ID 1054222）在IEEE BigData Cup 2026城市双生Sim2Real激光雷达挑战赛（V2X-Real赛道）中的工作。主要目标是仅使用合成路侧激光雷达数据训练用于车辆、行人和卡车的3D检测器，并生成与真实数据难以区分的逼真合成扫描数据。我们开发了一套基于CARLA的流程，并将其校准至固定传感器站点，基于未标注的真实开发扫描数据，精确建模距离图像，包括无返回光束的情况。此外，我们提出了一种组合推理检测器，使用多个仅基于合成数据训练的3D检测器（VoxelNeXt、PV-RCNN和SECOND）。每个扫描均与合成地面平面对齐，并在多个地面高度下通过检测器进行处理。最终生成的边界框通过鸟瞰图聚类进行融合，随后进行类别特定的后处理以优化航向角、框尺寸，并过滤低置信度检测结果。最终提交的综合得分为0.8947。消融研究表明，逐扫描地面水平化使真实扫描的平均精度提升了一倍以上，而跨不同高度和模型融合边界框进一步提升了性能。

Authors: Arnav Kumar, Brijesh Soni

Training-Free Anonymization of Driving Data with Promptable Segmentation and 3D Human Mesh Recovery AutonomousDriving

data anonymization promptable segmentation 3D human mesh recovery generative replacement autonomous driving privacy

简要说明：本文提出FM-Anonymize，一种无需训练的匿名化流水线，结合可提示分割和3D人体网格恢复，用于自动驾驶数据中的人脸和车牌匿名化，实现了高隐私召回率，并通过生成式人脸修复提升下游关键点检测性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces FM-Anonymize, a training-free pipeline that combines promptable segmentation (SAM) and 3D human mesh recovery to anonymize faces and license plates in driving data, achieving high privacy recall and improving downstream keypoint detection through optional generative face inpainting.

Abstract: Camera recordings for autonomous driving contain faces and license plates that should be anonymized before labeling, sharing, or training. Dedicated detectors can miss small plates and faces behind vehicle glass. We present FM-Anonymize, a training-free anonymization pipeline that combines promptable segmentation, 3D human mesh recovery, and generative replacement. SAM 3 locates people, faces, and vehicles and searches zoomed vehicle crops for plates, occupants, and windows. SAM 3D Body assesses face visibility from head orientation and projects head regions for blurring. Optional diffusion inpainting replaces eligible blurred heads with synthetic faces, guided by estimated pose and keypoints. On PP4AV, the blur pipeline protects 97.8% of faces and 95.5% of plates, the highest privacy recall of all compared methods at their default settings. On our recordings, where the localization thresholds were set, it protects 97.1% of faces and 93.4% of plates, compared with 93.7%/73.0% for UrbanAnonymizer, 42.7%/40.7% for EgoBlur, and 96.6% of faces for deface. Synthetic replacement raises full-body keypoint average precision over blurring from 54.1% to 79.6% on our recordings and from 39.9% to 68.3% on PP4AV. Code and configurations are available on https://github.com/max-a-ai/FM-Anonymize

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶的摄像头录制内容中包含人脸和车牌，在标注、共享或训练之前应对其进行匿名化处理。专用检测器可能漏检小型车牌以及车辆玻璃后的人脸。我们提出了FM-Anonymize，一种无需训练的匿名化流程，结合了可提示分割、3D人体网格恢复和生成式替换。SAM 3定位人员、人脸和车辆，并在放大的车辆裁剪图中搜索车牌、乘员和车窗。SAM 3D Body根据头部朝向评估人脸可见性，并投射头部区域进行模糊处理。可选的扩散模型修复以合成人脸替换符合条件且已模糊的头部，并由估计的姿态和关键点引导。在PP4AV数据集上，模糊流程保护了97.8%的人脸和95.5%的车牌，在默认设置下，其隐私召回率在所有对比方法中最高。在我们自己的录制数据（设定定位阈值的数据）上，它保护了97.1%的人脸和93.4%的车牌，而UrbanAnonymizer为93.7%/73.0%，EgoBlur为42.7%/40.7%，deface保护了96.6%的人脸。在我们的录制数据上，合成替换将全身关键点的平均精度从模糊处理的54.1%提升至79.6%，在PP4AV上则从39.9%提升至68.3%。代码和配置见https://github.com/max-a-ai/FM-Anonymize。

Authors: Max A. Buettner, Mark Azer, Fabian B. Flohr

Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation RLRobot

continual reinforcement learning hierarchical reinforcement learning explainable behavior Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy inference robotic navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种模糊可解释的持续分层强化学习方法，用于机器人导航，在顺序多场景导航任务中平衡策略适应性与可解释的行为演化，解决了持续学习与可解释性之间的冲突。

TLDR: This paper introduces a fuzzy explainable continual hierarchical reinforcement learning method that balances policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution for robotic navigation, addressing the conflict between continual learning and explainability in sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks.

Abstract: Continual robot navigation requires reinforcement learning policies to continuously adapt to new environments while retaining previously acquired knowledge. Meanwhile, explainable reinforcement learning aims to learn meaningful behavioral representations through policy interaction. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, as continual learning emphasizes policy stability whereas explainable behavior learning requires adaptive exploration. Existing methods rarely address both simultaneously. To resolve this issue, this paper proposes a Fuzzy Explainable Continual Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (FECHRL) method. A two-stage behavior cloning strategy is introduced to balance rapid policy adaptation and explainable behavior evolution by progressively transitioning from strong imitation guidance to autonomous reinforcement learning. Furthermore, a fuzzy critic based on a Takagi--Sugeno fuzzy inference system is proposed to alleviate value extrapolation errors during the transition between imitation-guided learning and autonomous exploration, thereby improving continual training stability. Experimental results on sequential multi-scenario navigation tasks demonstrate that the proposed method effectively unifies continual learning capability and policy explainability within a single reinforcement learning framework, achieving stable knowledge retention and meaningful behavioral explanation.

摘要（中文）：持续机器人导航要求强化学习策略在保留已有知识的同时，不断适应新环境。与此同时，可解释强化学习旨在通过策略交互学习具有意义的行为表征。然而，这两个目标本质上存在冲突，因为持续学习强调策略稳定性，而可解释行为学习则要求自适应探索。现有方法很少同时兼顾两者。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种模糊可解释持续分层强化学习方法（FECHRL）。引入两阶段行为克隆策略，通过从强模仿引导逐步过渡到自主强化学习，平衡策略快速适应与可解释行为演化之间的关系。此外，提出了一种基于Takagi-Sugeno模糊推理系统的模糊评论家网络，以缓解模仿引导学习与自主探索过渡期间的价值外推误差，从而提升持续训练的稳定性。在连续多场景导航任务上的实验结果表明，所提方法能够在统一的强化学习框架内有效统一持续学习能力与策略可解释性，实现稳定的知识保持和有意义的行为解释。

Authors: Peng Qin, Tao Zhao

Déjà-Events: Multi-view 3D Geometry with Event Cameras via Sparsity-Aware Adaptive Gating Perception3D

event cameras multi-view 3D reconstruction knowledge distillation sparsity-aware adaptive gating depth estimation

简要说明：Déjà-Events 将前馈 RGB 多视图 3D 重建模型（Déjà View）蒸馏为仅使用事件相机的学生模型，通过稀疏感知自适应门控处理事件稀疏性，在 EventScape、MVSEC 和 DSEC 上取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: Déjà-Events distills a feed-forward RGB multi-view 3D reconstruction model (Déjà View) into an event-only student that predicts depth, pose, and pointmaps from multiple event camera views, introducing sparsity-aware adaptive gating to handle event sparsity and achieve state-of-the-art results on EventScape, MVSEC, and DSEC.

Abstract: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.

摘要（中文）：事件相机能够在传统相机模糊或饱和的场景中持续捕捉结构信息，这使其在快速运动或光照不足场景下的三维感知中具有吸引力。然而，带有稠密三维真值的事件数据集在规模和多样性上远不及用于前馈三维重建模型的图像数据集。我们提出Déjà-Events，一种仅使用事件数据的模型，能够在单次前向传播中从多视角预测深度、相机位姿和点图。我们不依赖稀缺的三维标注，而是从Déjà View中蒸馏该模型——Déjà View是一种前馈RGB模型，通过重复应用一个共享Transformer块来优化其令牌。在成对的RGB和事件记录上，事件学生模型学习复现冻结教师模型的最终令牌，这一过程不需要深度或位姿真值，且仅训练约1%的参数。由于事件在边缘和运动纹理处密集，而在无纹理区域几乎缺失，我们进一步引入了稀疏感知自适应门控，该机制将共享块的门控适配到事件数据，并根据事件密度对每个补丁进行调整，从而在增加细化步骤时保持精度。仅使用模拟数据训练的Déjà-Events，在我们评估的基于事件的方法中，在EventScape数据集上取得了最低的点图误差，并在真实的MVSEC和DSEC数据集上实现了零样本泛化。在DSEC上，它将其误差减半于最强基线（0.15对比0.30 AbsRel），同时参数量仅为后者的十分之一左右。此外，它在EventScape和DSEC上取得了最低的深度误差，在EventScape上取得了最低的轨迹误差。

Inverse Kinematics in Endoscopic Scenarios using MoveIt Manipulation

Inverse Kinematics MoveIt Endoscopic Benchmark Constrained environments

简要说明：本文在受限内窥镜场景下对标定了多种逆运动学求解器，并提出将IK问题分解为两部分的方法，在腔内水箱场景中实现了100%的成功率且耗时低于100毫秒。

TLDR: This paper benchmarks inverse kinematics solvers in confined endoscopic scenarios and proposes splitting the IK problem into two parts, achieving a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.

Abstract: Inverse kinematics are critical in many robotic applications, yet standard MoveIt-based solvers struggle in confined scenarios. This paper provides a benchmark of the available solvers and compares multiple practical modifications for improving the performance of the solvers. Splitting the IK problem into two parts results in the best performance, leading to a 100% success rate under 100 ms in an endoscopic tank scenario.

摘要（中文）：逆运动学在许多机器人应用中至关重要，然而基于MoveIt的标准求解器在受限场景中表现不佳。本文对现有求解器进行了基准测试，并比较了多种提升求解器性能的实用改进方法。将逆运动学问题分解为两部分能获得最佳性能，在内镜水箱场景下，100毫秒内成功率可达100%。

Authors: Marc Bestmann, Timon Engelke, Rebecca Rodeck, Gerko Wende

TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation Other

thermal simulation RGB-thermal data generation robot manipulation contact modeling benchmark

简要说明：TRR 提出了一种热机器人渲染器，通过模拟热量保留、传输和交换，为机器人仿真生成同步的 RGB-热数据，并构建了六个任务的基准，证明热历史能提高接触点选择和任务完成率。

TLDR: TRR introduces a Thermal Robot Renderer that generates synchronized RGB-thermal data for robot simulation by modeling heat retention, transport, and exchange, enabling a six-task benchmark and showing that thermal history improves contact-site selection and transfer completion in robotic control.

Abstract: A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\% to 91.7\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.

摘要（中文）：机器人的动作会改变其下一次交互的热条件：释放后残留的热量、随物体携带的热量或储存在表面下的热量，即便当前温度相似，也可能改变后续接触的结果。训练轨迹必须捕捉这些效应如何将早期动作与后续观测及任务结果联系起来。我们提出TRR，一种\emph{热机器人渲染器}（Thermal Robot Renderer），它将空间分辨率和深度分辨率的热状态同时附着于两个接触对象，通过接触、搬运和分离更新局部热交换，并在同一执行时钟上生成同步的RGB-热（RGBT）观测和事件局部任务检查。受控干预实验展示了残留热量、空间搬运和内部存储为何对后续接触结果至关重要。从相同状态出发，TRR生成一个配对的六任务基准，包含2,224对静态-动态样本，即4,448条轨迹，并附带同步的双视角观测、状态和动作。可见的热历史将专用学习语料上的安全接触点选择率从75.0\%提升至91.7\%；在共享反馈执行的新加热程序下，基于动态历史的训练将模拟转移完成率提高了50个百分点。我们在MuJoCo和Isaac Sim上展示了RGBT观测适配器，报告了包含十个预配置机器人配置和六个演示相机视角的工程清单，并描述了一个将现有机器人场景转换为导出RGBT记录的开发者工作流程。第6节所述的基准、工作流程和平台资源构成了计划中公开发布的首批内容。演示和资源更新可在项目页面上获取。

Authors: Biwen Yang, Zhe Cao, Jin Zhang, Haoyang Sun, Zonglu Hu, Jintao Zhao, Zhehao Zhang, Kaizheng Chen, Chengyi Liu, Chengyu Wei, Siyuan Wu, Ruiheng Zhang

Non-Imaging Optical Tactile Sensors for Robotics: Transduction Principles, System Integration, and Robotic Applications Other

tactile sensors non-imaging optical force estimation contact localization robotic touch

简要说明：本综述为非成像光学触觉传感器提供了统一框架，分析了传感原理、系统集成和机器人应用，并强调校准、读出和基于任务的验证。

TLDR: This review provides a unified framework for non-imaging optical tactile sensors, analyzing transduction principles, system integration, and robotic applications with emphasis on calibration, readout, and task-based validation.

Abstract: Non-imaging optical tactile sensors encode contact through changes in optical intensity, wavelength, spectra, or photon counts, offering diverse architectures for robotic touch. Their usefulness depends on whether contact variables can be reliably distinguished from coupled mechanical and environmental effects, and whether the resulting information can be delivered in time to guide action. This review develops a unified framework linking mechanical load transmission, optical encoding, readout, and tactile inference to robotic task requirements. It examines reflective and waveguide-based devices, micro/nanofibers, fiber gratings, interferometric and resonant structures, and mechanoluminescent composites. Three considerations emerge across these approaches. First, high optical sensitivity supports accurate tactile estimation only when target variables remain identifiable under the relevant contact and calibration conditions. Second, spatial coverage and feedback timing must be assessed at the system level, accounting for multiplexing, acquisition, demodulation, and inference. Third, device characterization, offline recognition, and closed-loop robotic performance provide distinct levels of evidence and require different evaluation criteria. Representative studies illustrate how these considerations shape force estimation, contact localization, slip correction and distributed interaction. This review concludes with priorities for calibration transfer, reliable interfaces, scalable readout, and task-based validation, providing a basis for selecting and developing non-imaging optical tactile architectures for robotics.

摘要（中文）：非成像光学触觉传感器通过光强度、波长、光谱或光子计数的变化来编码接触信息，为机器人触觉提供了多种架构选择。其效用取决于接触变量能否与耦合的机械及环境效应可靠区分，以及所获取的信息能否及时传递以指导动作执行。本综述建立了一个统一框架，将机械载荷传递、光学编码、信号读取及触觉推断与机器人任务需求相衔接。研究涵盖了反射式及波导式器件、微纳光纤、光纤光栅、干涉与谐振结构，以及力致发光复合材料。在这些技术路径中，有三个关键考量因素浮现出来。第一，高光学灵敏度仅在相关接触与标定条件下目标变量保持可辨识时，才能支撑精确的触觉估计。第二，空间覆盖范围与反馈时序需在系统层面进行综合评估，须考虑多路复用、采集、解调及推断各环节。第三，器件表征、离线识别与闭环机器人性能分别提供不同层次的证据，需要采用不同的评价标准。代表性研究说明了这些考量因素如何影响力估计、接触定位、滑移校正及分布式交互。本综述最后提出了标定迁移、可靠接口、可扩展读取及基于任务的验证方面的优先事项，为机器人领域非成像光学触觉架构的选择与开发提供了基础。

TLDR: The paper presents a smart electric scooter prototype that uses computer vision for automatic lane detection and configuration adjustment, focusing on safety and security constraints.

Abstract: The authors present a prototype of an electric scooter that uses computer vision to determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. Scooters steer on sidewalks, bike paths, or car lanes. The government imposes speed limits on the lanes in which electric scooters drive. Featuring computer vision, electric scooters can determine driving lanes and automatically modify vehicle configuration. However, such systems' safety is still a concern, and research into such vehicle systems' safety and security aspects is proceeding. First, we will present our vehicular setup. Then, we will present our implemented scooter with safety constraints. Finally, we present our security prototype for such an electric scooter.

Authors: Hamid Reza Ghaeini, Nils Ole Tippenhauer

JEPTERA: A Platform Agnostic JEPA-Assisted Model Predictive Planner for Urban UAV Navigation Other

JEPA Model Predictive Control UAV navigation safety layer simulator portability

简要说明：JEPTERA 将基于 JEPA 的预测器与 MPC、PID 和安全层集成，用于城市无人机导航，并通过消融研究展示了其在 Gazebo、MuJoCo 和 CARLA 模拟器之间的可移植性。

TLDR: JEPTERA integrates a JEPA-based predictor with MPC, PID, and a safety layer for urban UAV navigation, demonstrating portability across Gazebo, MuJoCo, and CARLA simulators via an ablation study.

Abstract: Urban navigation for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) requires planning that accounts for environmental geometry, vehicle dynamics, and moving obstacles. This paper presents JEPTERA, a navigation architecture that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), Model Predictive Control (MPC), PID control, and a safety layer. JEPA predicts the UAV's motion response to candidate commands for MPC action selection, while the safety layer checks trajectories against occupied space and predicted obstacle motion. Simulator adapters and platform-specific YAML configurations separate the planning core from simulator interfaces. An ablation study evaluated six configurations across three gym scenarios, totaling 180 runs. The complete architecture achieved the highest aggregate success rate, completing 28 of 30 runs. Additional tests completed one route across three city maps without collisions. Separate integration tests demonstrated operation in Gazebo/ROS 2, MuJoCo, and CARLA without modifying the core planning logic. These results support the feasibility of the integrated architecture for simulated urban UAV navigation and its portability across simulator interfaces.

摘要（中文）：摘要：无人机（UAV）的城市导航需要综合考虑环境几何、飞行器动力学及动态障碍物的规划方案。本文提出了一种名为JEPTERA的导航架构，该架构融合了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）、模型预测控制（MPC）、PID控制及安全层。JEPA用于预测无人机对候选指令的机动响应，以辅助MPC进行动作选择，而安全层则根据占用空间及预测的障碍物运动对轨迹进行校验。模拟器适配器及平台特定的YAML配置将规划核心与模拟器接口相分离。消融研究在三个健身房场景中评估了六种配置，总计运行180次。完整架构取得了最高的总体成功率，30次运行中完成28次。额外测试在三个城市地图中完成了一条路线且无碰撞。单独的集成测试表明，在不修改核心规划逻辑的情况下，该架构可运行于Gazebo/ROS 2、MuJoCo及CARLA环境。这些结果支持了集成架构在模拟城市无人机导航中的可行性及其在不同模拟器接口间的可移植性。

Authors: Gibran Fathoni Belva, Mansur Arief, Ahmad Alfan Alfian Irfan

OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark Perception3D

LiDAR place recognition bird's-eye view polar Fourier spectrum phase correlation point-anchored height columns

简要说明：OrthoMark 是一种无需训练的 LiDAR 位置识别方法，利用鸟瞰图的极坐标频谱进行候选检索，并使用点锚定高度列进行验证，在 KITTI 和多机器人序列上以紧凑描述符实现了高精度。

TLDR: OrthoMark is a training-free LiDAR place recognition method that uses a polar spectrum of bird's-eye views for candidate retrieval and point-anchored height columns for verification, achieving high accuracy on KITTI and multi-robot sequences with a compact descriptor.

Abstract: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.

摘要（中文）：摘要：LiDAR位置识别为同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）提供回环检测。从Z轴视角看，重力对齐的扫描是场景的正射投影图，从不同位置和航向再次访问时，该图在平面内发生刚性移动，这种运动被极坐标傅里叶频谱忽略，却能被相位相关恢复。在垂直方向上，回波高度描述结构特征，但观测到哪些高度取决于距离，因为传感器的垂直视场会截断近处结构的低部；因此高度信息在全局关键词中具有误导性，但一旦两个扫描对齐并在重叠区域逐单元比较时，高度信息则具有决定性作用。我们提出\method方法，这是一种基于单一原理的无训练方法：两个LiDAR扫描只能通过从两个扫描中相同的几何表面计算出的特征进行比较。\method通过鸟瞰图（BEV）的平移和旋转不变极坐标频谱检索候选，每个关键帧仅占1.9KB，并通过相位相关估计平面位姿来验证每个候选，使用\emph{点锚定高度列}进行评分：每个BEV单元保留其自身回波高度的16位掩码；在同一会话内，得分根据两个扫描传感范围的重叠程度进行加权，该重叠程度由其距离计算得出。我们证明这种垂直关联在验证中效果显著，但在检索中却有害，因为高度切片所包含的内容取决于到结构的距离。对于单机器人，\method在KITTI开发序列上无需3D配准的无训练方法中具有最高的AP；跨机器人场景下，在所有多机器人序列中，它以1/350的描述符大小达到或超过RING++的性能，并在所有测试中比学习的BEVPlace++闭合更多的机器人间回环。

Authors: Haichuan Li

VoxSAOR: Semantic-Aware Occupancy Robustification via Aleatoric Uncertainty Modeling Perception3D

3D occupancy prediction aleatoric uncertainty semantic occupancy autonomous driving ensemble learning

简要说明：VoxSAOR 通过特征空间代理建模偶然不确定性和集成学习，增强了用于自动驾驶的基于视觉的 3D 语义占用预测，提高了准确性、长尾识别和校准。

TLDR: VoxSAOR enhances vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by modeling aleatoric uncertainty via feature-space proxies and ensemble learning, improving accuracy, long-tail recognition, and calibration.

Abstract: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction provides a dense semantic representation of scenes for autonomous driving and embodied perception, yet remains vulnerable to occlusion, depth ambiguity, and projection errors that induce spatially varying reliability in voxel features. Existing methods typically map voxel representations to semantic predictions without explicitly modeling such observation-induced feature variations. To address this limitation, we propose VoxSAOR, a semantic-aware occupancy robustification framework that models aleatoric uncertainty through feature-space proxies. It first quantifies Local Semantic Consistency (LSC) to derive a voxel-wise structural stability prior and uses cross-view semantic consensus to filter unreliable semantic correspondences. Within each semantic category, spatially matched stable and ambiguous voxels form stable-to-ambiguous feature transitions, which are modeled by a class-conditional diagonal Gaussian distribution, capturing both feature displacement and dispersion. Guided by these proxy distributions, Aleatoric Regime Ensemble Learning (AREL) trains independently parameterized prediction heads using feature perturbations at progressively increasing scales, with perturbation strength modulated by structural reliability. At inference, proxy modeling and sampling are disabled, and all heads process the same observed features; their output probabilities are then averaged to produce a deterministic consensus prediction without requiring sampling. Experiments across multiple datasets and occupancy backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of VoxSAOR in improving semantic occupancy prediction, long-tail recognition, and predictive calibration. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的三维占用预测为自动驾驶和具身感知提供了场景的密集语义表示，但仍然容易受到遮挡、深度模糊和投影误差的影响，这些因素会导致体素特征在空间上具有可变可靠性。现有方法通常将体素表示直接映射为语义预测，而没有显式建模这种由观测引起的特征变化。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了VoxSAOR，一种通过特征空间代理来建模偶然不确定性的语义感知占用鲁棒化框架。该框架首先量化局部语义一致性（LSC），以推导逐体素的结构稳定性先验，并利用跨视图语义一致性过滤不可靠的语义对应关系。在每个语义类别内，空间匹配的稳定体素与模糊体素形成稳定到模糊的特征迁移，并通过类条件对角高斯分布进行建模，从而捕获特征位移和离散程度。在这些代理分布的引导下，偶然机制集成学习（AREL）使用逐步增大尺度的特征扰动训练独立参数化的预测头，扰动强度由结构可靠性调制。在推理阶段，代理建模和采样被禁用，所有预测头处理相同的观测特征；随后将其输出概率进行平均，以产生确定性共识预测，无需采样。在多个数据集和占用骨干网络上的实验证明了VoxSAOR在提升语义占用预测、长尾识别和预测校准方面的有效性。源代码将在https://github.com/MengfeiD/VoxSAOR公开提供。

Authors: Mengfei Duan, Yuheng Zhang, Guoqiang Zhao, Yuanfan Zheng, Kailun Yang, Zhiyong Li

Making Koopman Control Guarantees Hold on Robots RLRobot

Koopman control stability transfer bilinear predictor LQR robustness margin

简要说明：本文提出了切不变Koopman（TIK）方法，通过强制学习到的潜在线性动态与真实非线性系统的一阶匹配，确保基于Koopman的控制器在实际机器人上稳定，并在模拟不稳定基准和操作任务中验证了有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), a method that enforces first-order matching between the learned latent linear dynamics and the true nonlinear plant to ensure that Koopman-based controllers stabilize real robots, demonstrating success on simulated unstable benchmarks and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: A Koopman controller can stabilize its learned latent-space linear model yet fail to stabilize the nonlinear plant. The learned model propagates predictions in latent space, while the deployed controller repeatedly re-encodes the measured physical state. We show that nominal closed-loop stability transfers to the nonlinear plant when the learned and true closed-loop dynamics agree to first order on the embedding's tangent space at the target. We derive a robustness margin for approximate matching and show that a stable open-loop latent model cannot exactly match an unstable equilibrium. We introduce Tangent-Invariant Koopman (TIK), which estimates a local plant linearization from offline transitions and enforces first-order matching to this estimate. TIK recovers the fitted LQR gain at the target, while a bilinear predictor captures state-dependent actuation during large maneuvers. Across four simulated unstable benchmarks, all 40 Standard Koopman controllers have stable latent closed loops, but their deployed nonlinear systems are locally unstable. In contrast, all 40 TIK controllers locally stabilize their respective nonlinear plants. An offline stability test using empirical curvature estimates identifies stable TIK controllers on two cart-pole systems, but is inconclusive under high noise. Under explicit model-error and curvature bounds, an invariant terminal set guarantees constraint satisfaction after entry under local feedback. TIK achieves 88\% constrained cart-pole swing-up success with a 0.25 ms planning budget and controls simulated seven-joint arms within 1-5 ms per step.

摘要（中文）：一种Koopman控制器能够稳定其学习得到的潜在线性模型，却可能无法稳定非线性被控对象。学习到的模型在潜空间中进行预测传播，而部署的控制器则反复对测量的物理状态进行重新编码。我们证明，当学习到的闭环动力学与真实闭环动力学在目标点处嵌入切空间上达到一阶一致时，标称闭环稳定性可传递至非线性被控对象。我们推导了近似匹配的鲁棒裕度，并表明稳定的开环潜模型无法精确匹配不稳定的平衡点。我们提出了切变不变的Koopman（TIK）方法，该方法从离线转换中估计局部被控对象线性化，并对该估计强制实施一阶匹配。TIK在目标点处恢复拟合的LQR增益，同时双线性预测器捕捉大机动过程中与状态相关的执行作用。在四个模拟的不稳定基准测试中，所有40个标准Koopman控制器均具有稳定的潜闭环，但其所部署的非线性系统在局部是不稳定的。相比之下，所有40个TIK控制器均能局部稳定各自对应的非线性被控对象。一种利用经验曲率估计的离线稳定性测试，能够在两个车摆系统上识别出稳定的TIK控制器，但在高噪声下该测试结果不确定。在显式的模型误差和曲率界限下，不变终端集保证了进入后局部反馈下的约束满足性。TIK在0.25毫秒的规划预算下实现了88%的约束车摆摆动上升成功率，并以每步1-5毫秒的速度控制模拟的七关节机械臂。

Authors: Abulikemu Abuduweili, Changliu Liu

Course-Referenced Lateral Control of Trail-Following Convoys: String Stability and Adaptive Feedforward under Load Uncertainty AutonomousDriving

trail-following convoy string stability adaptive feedforward course reference GNSS trails

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于航向参考的队列轨迹跟随横向控制方法，分析了串稳定性，并提出了一种自适应前馈算法来处理载荷不确定性，通过11辆车队列的仿真验证了分析。

TLDR: This paper presents a course-referenced lateral control method for convoy trail-following, analyzing string stability and proposing an adaptive feedforward algorithm to handle load uncertainty, verified in simulations of an 11-vehicle convoy.

Abstract: Vehicles in a convoy can steer along the GNSS trails of the vehicles ahead when lane markings are unavailable, as on snow covered roads. Since each vehicle's tracking error enters the reference of the next, lateral errors can grow along the convoy. This paper presents a course referenced formulation of trail following in arc length, in which each follower takes the direction of its fitted trail as its heading reference. Error propagation then reduces to a single transfer function. We derive a condition under which combining the trails of the leader and the predecessor keeps the errors bounded for any convoy length, and show that following the predecessor alone lets the errors accumulate without bound, even without amplification, on roads that end turned or shifted sideways. Passenger and cargo loads and tire stiffness vary in practice, and we show that they enter the curvature feedforward through a single coefficient, whose mismatch leaves steady offsets on curves. We propose an adaptive law that estimates this coefficient on curves and removes the offsets. Simulations of an eleven vehicle convoy confirm the analysis.

摘要（中文）：车辆在队列中行驶时，若车道标线不可用（如积雪覆盖的道路），可沿前方车辆的GNSS轨迹进行转向引导。由于每辆车的跟踪误差会进入下一辆车的参考轨迹，横向误差可能沿队列累积增长。本文提出了一种基于弧长的曲线参考轨迹跟踪方法，其中每辆跟随车辆将其拟合轨迹的方向作为航向参考。由此，误差传播简化为单一传递函数。我们推导出一个条件，在该条件下，结合领航车与前车的轨迹可确保任意长度的队列误差有界，并证明仅跟随前车轨迹时，即使不存在放大效应，在道路末端转弯或侧向偏移的路况下，误差仍会无界累积。实际中，乘客与货物载荷以及轮胎刚度会发生变化，我们证明这些因素通过单一系数进入曲率前馈项，该系数的不匹配会导致弯道上的稳态偏差。我们提出一种自适应律，用于在弯道上估计该系数并消除偏差。对十一辆车队列的仿真验证了上述分析。

Authors: Nitesh Kumar, Sixu Li, Swaroop Darbha

Ontology-Compiled Control Barrier Functions for Heterogeneous Robot Teams Other

control barrier functions heterogeneous robot teams domain ontology safety filters multi-robot PPO

简要说明：本文介绍了OntoCBF，一种将领域本体编译为异构机器人团队的控制屏障函数的方法，动态生成安全约束并解决冲突，以提高多机器人系统的安全性。

TLDR: This paper introduces OntoCBF, a method that compiles domain ontologies into control barrier functions for heterogeneous robot teams, dynamically generating safety constraints and addressing conflicts to improve safety in multi-robot systems.

Abstract: Safety filters for heterogeneous robot teams fail because of missing constraints, overestimated braking capabilities and conflicts between individually satisfiable constraints. We present OntoCBF, which compiles a domain ontology with a class taxonomy, typed relations, safety axioms and a dynamics profile per robot class into a control barrier function filter with one quadratic program per agent. Description-logic entailment supplies the constraints of any team online, including those that follow from chains of relations and from classes defined by what a robot carries, so the existing safety axioms cover new robot classes, payload classes and combinations. We prove that a subclass may reuse the braking capability of its parent whenever it can produce every velocity of the parent, a property separate from subsumption. For box-bounded double integrators this property is also necessary, and every loss of safety then begins with a conflict. Once three robots interact, the safe set of pairwise barriers contains states from which a collision is unavoidable, and such states persist in larger teams under any fixed capability reduction. In a simulated warehouse where humans ignore the robots, a filter written for the design classes violates safety in 89-100 % of the episodes with unseen classes. In all scenarios, including one with 32 robots, OntoCBF violates safety in 20-70 % of the episodes, each time after a conflict, with a median deepest intrusion of 10-17 % of the keep-out distance. A multi-agent PPO policy trained with the filter in the loop lowers the rate of infeasible quadratic programs, nearly all of them conflicts, by 18-41 %.

摘要（中文）：异构机器人团队的安全过滤器因缺少约束、高估制动能力以及各可满足约束之间的冲突而失效。我们提出OntoCBF，它将领域本体（包含类分类体系、类型化关系、安全公理及各机器人类的动力学配置）编译为控制障碍函数过滤器，每个智能体对应一个二次规划问题。描述逻辑蕴含关系在线提供任意团队的约束，包括由关系链及依据机器人所载物定义的类所推导出的约束，因此现有安全公理可覆盖新的机器人类、载荷类及其组合。我们证明，当子类能够产生父类的所有速度时，其可复用父类的制动能力，该性质独立于包含关系。对于箱式有界双积分器，该性质亦为必要条件，且任何安全性丧失均始于冲突。当三个机器人交互时，成对障碍物的安全集合包含无法避免碰撞的状态，且在任意固定能力缩减下，此类状态在更大规模的团队中持续存在。在模拟仓库中，人类无视机器人，为设计类别编写的过滤器在含未见类别的测试中于89-100%的回合内违反安全性。在所有场景中（包括含32个机器人的场景），OntoCBF在20-70%的回合中违反安全性，每次均在冲突之后，中位最大侵入深度为隔离距离的10-17%。在过滤器参与闭环训练的多智能体PPO策略，将不可行二次规划（几乎均为冲突）的发生率降低了18-41%。

Authors: Peng Wu, Seyede Fatemeh Ghoreishi, Nathan Bastian, Mohsen Imani, Tian Lan, Mahdi Imani

Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark Perception3D

sim-to-real pose estimation conformal calibration domain adaptation robustness

简要说明：本文分析了模拟器规格错误下基于视觉的航天器姿态估计的仿真到真实差距，表明合成数据上的保形校准高估了现实领域的置信度，并且骨干适应比增强或数据缩放更为有效。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the sim-to-real gap in vision-based spacecraft pose estimation under simulator misspecification, showing that conformal calibration on synthetic data overestimates confidence on real domains and that backbone adaptation transfers better than augmentation or data scaling.

Abstract: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的轨道导航系统几乎完全依赖合成图像进行训练，因为现实中很少存在带有标注的在轨航天器图像。SPEED+等基准正是针对这一情况而构建：训练集来自仿真器，测试集则是在两种光照条件下拍摄的卫星模型真实图像。该仿真器近似模拟了光线在聚酯薄膜和铝材表面的反射，但与其他科学仿真器一样，其模型存在设定偏差。其误差属于辐射度量层面，因为它未能捕捉真实图像中常见的镜面高光、硬阴影和传感器饱和现象。我们以一个刻意简化的单目姿态估计器为工具，深入探究由此产生的合成到真实域的迁移差距——这是此类系统的核心风险。在一项关于主干网络适配与光度增强的2×2研究中，模型在合成图像上训练，并在两个真实硬件在环域上测试，我们发现三点结论。(1) 模型并未意识到自身失效：在合成数据上经过保形校准达到90%置信度的区域，在日光灯域仅覆盖旋转误差的9-15%，在灯箱域仅覆盖21-38%，这意味着错误的姿态携带了与正确姿态相当的置信度。(2) 迁移具有不对称性：扩大数据量和特征规模使合成域旋转误差从1.65弧度降至1.03弧度，但对光照严苛的日光灯域仅改善0.05弧度，不足其种子标准差的二倍；而适配主干网络的最后一个阶段，则将其额外的合成域增益的63-83%传递到了两个真实域。(3) 一旦主干网络完成适配，数据增强仅在其所建模的方向上发挥作用：我们的光度增强策略在每次种子运行中均将漫光照明的灯箱域误差从1.17弧度降至0.99弧度，但对日光灯域的影响不超过种子间差异；而当主干网络冻结时，该增强策略对日光灯域的帮助反而更大。所有评审后的实验均已预先注册，代码、逐图像预测结果及预注册记录见 https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation。
